descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Strategy& è la consulenza strategica globale di PwC. In Svizzera, sosteniamo principalmente le aziende svizzere nella definizione della loro presenza internazionale – dalla strategia della sede centrale alla trasformazione delle aree commerciali globali. Sviluppiamo strategie su misura per aziende leader basate su chiaramente differenziando i vantaggi competitivi. Il nostro team è caratterizzato da una coesione particolarmente ravvicinata: dagli eventi di ufficio alle emozionanti location attraverso la cena di squadra regolare e gli eventi di team building – il divertimento al lavoro non è troppo breve. ## Mansioni - # Come manager: nel Team Strategy & Transformation lavori con le principali organizzazioni nazionali e internazionali di diverse industrie. - No. Insieme al vostro team, sviluppate strategie e concetti lungo l'intera catena del valore – dai modelli aziendali e operativi alle strategie tecnologiche e digitali ai programmi di trasformazione. - Lei conduce progetti (partiali), controlla i team interdisciplinari e funge da interfaccia tra clienti, partner: all'interno e agli stakeholder interni. - No. Lavori a stretto contatto con colleghi di diverse aree di consulenza e utilizzi le competenze della nostra rete globale per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni olistiche. - No. Inoltre, si prende un mentore: in-house, promuovere lo sviluppo dei vostri colleghi e contribuire attivamente a una cultura del team aperta e collaborativa. - Attraverso la formazione si approfondisce continuamente il metodo, la leadership e le competenze del settore. - No. Nei progetti, si analizzano questioni complesse dei nostri clienti: all'interno, strutturando i problemi e sviluppando soluzioni strategiche con un valore aggiunto sostenibile. - Argomenti tipici sono: - Sviluppo di strategie aziendali, aziendali e digitali - Riprogettazione di modelli di business e operativi - Pianificazione e realizzazione di programmi di trasformazione e cambiamento - Supporto per iniziative M&A, carve-out e strategie di portafoglio - Ottimizzazione di organizzazioni, processi e catene di valore - Utilizzo di dati, analisi e nuove tecnologie per il supporto decisionale - Sei responsabile dei risultati di bilancio per i tuoi progetti e garantire la qualità. - No. Inoltre, si supporta attivamente l'acquisizione di nuovi progetti, sviluppare offerte e ampliare le relazioni con i clienti esistenti. ##
• Requisiti - Sfondo accademico: diploma universitario superiore alla media (Master, MBA o PhD) in economia, (economico) informatica, (economico)ingegneria, scienze naturali o scienze sociali, statistica/informatica o un'area tematica comparabile. - Esperienza professionale: Esperienza pluriennale in una consulenza strategica superiore o in funzioni aziendali responsabili, idealmente concentrandosi su strategia, trasformazione, digitalizzazione o miglioramento delle prestazioni. Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nell'offerta di sviluppo e acquisizione di progetti. - Esperienza internazionale: esperienza all'estero attraverso lo studio o la professione e il movimento sicuro in contesti internazionali e interculturali. - Forza di comunicazione: ottime capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta in tedesco e inglese. Capacità di rendere chiari i contenuti complessi e di presentare in modo convincente prima dei corpi decisionali e di leadership. - Competenza analitica: Forte competenze analitiche e funzionamento strutturato con la capacità di catturare rapidamente situazioni complesse e tradurli in raccomandazioni possibili. - affinità digitale: Sicuro da usare strumenti comuni (ad esempio Excel, PowerPoint) e aperto all'analisi dei dati moderna e agli strumenti AI; La conoscenza dell'elaborazione dei dati, del software statistico o dei linguaggi di programmazione è vantaggiosa. - Profilo personale: Alta iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del team. L'orientamento del cliente goffrato e pretendere di ottenere un effetto sostenibile sui clienti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione Strategy& is the global strategy consultancy of PwC. In Switzerland, we mainly support leading Swiss companies in shaping their international presence – from the strategy at the headquarters to the transformation of global business areas. We develop tailor-made strategies for leading companies based on clearly differentiating competitive advantages. Our team is characterized by particularly close cohesion: from office events to exciting locations via regular team dinner and team building events – the fun at work is not too short. ## Mansioni - As a manager:in the Strategy & Transformation Team you work with leading national and international organizations from different industries. - Together with your team, you develop strategies and concepts along the entire value chain – from business and operating models to technology and digital strategies to transformation programs. - You conduct (partial) projects, control interdisciplinary teams and act as an interface between customers, partners: inside and internal stakeholders. - You work closely with colleagues from different consulting areas and use the expertise of our global network to develop and implement holistic solutions. - In addition, you take a mentor: in-house, promote the development of your colleagues and actively contribute to an open, collaborative team culture. - Through training you continuously deepen your method, leadership and industry skills. - In projects, you analyze complex questions of our customers: inside, structuring problems and developing strategic solutions with sustainable added value. - Typical topics are: - Development of corporate, business and digital strategies - Redesign of business and operating models - Planning and implementation of transformation and change programs - Support for M&A initiatives, carve-outs and portfolio strategies - Optimization of organizations, processes and value chains - Use of data, analytics and new technologies for decision support - You are responsible for budget results for your projects and ensure quality. - In addition, you actively support the acquisition of new projects, develop offers and expand existing customer relationships. ##
• Requisiti - Academic background: above-average university degree (Master, MBA or PhD) in economics, (economic) informatics, (economic)engineering, natural sciences or social sciences, statistics/data science or a comparable subject area. - Professional experience: Multiannual experience in a top strategy consulting or in responsible corporate functions, ideally focusing on strategy, transformation, digitization or performance improvement. Experience in managing projects as well as in offering development and project acquisition. - International experience: experience abroad through study or profession and safe movement in international and intercultural contexts. - Communication strength: Very good oral and written communication skills in German and English. Ability to make complex content clear and to present convincingly before decision-making and leadership bodies. - Analytical Competence: Strong Analytical Skills and Structured Operation with the ability to quickly capture complex situations and translate them into feasible recommendations. - Digital affinity: Safe to use common tools (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint) as well as open to modern data analysis and AI tools; Knowledge of data processing, statistical software or programming languages is advantageous. - Personal profile: High initiative, sense of responsibility and team orientation. Embossed customer orientation and claim to achieve a sustainable effect on customers.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager –Technology Strategy & Transformation Consulting
jobs.description:
Our “Technology Strategy & Transformation” team of 40 Management and Technology Consultants in Switzerland spearheads PwC's technology consulting practice. We have the privilege to work with many of the leading companies in the market and new and growing businesses. To best serve our clients in Switzerland and globally, we collaborate closely with our global PwC network. Being part of our high-spirited team provides an exciting, diverse, and inclusive culture.

• Lead and support exciting technology strategy and transformation projects for our clients in various industries.

• Closely work with executives in the technology environment and develop digital strategies as well as effective business models.

• Develop creative, high-quality solutions to current challenges of our clients in the key areas of technology strategy, organization, operating-model, assessment and other related topics.

• Actively involved in the further development of the service offering for Technology Strategy & Transformation Advisory and drive the acquisition of new projects and customers.

• Work in an inspiring team and an international network, receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors and have access to first-class training in the areas of technical know-how and soft skills.

• Take responsibility for employees in the role of coach and accompany your coachees in their professional and career development.

• A scientific and/or technical background (especially computer science, mathematics, natural sciences and engineering) or in economics and bring 6 to 9 years of experience in leading and supporting strategic technology or transformation projects.

jobs.title: IAM Architect
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• Define and implement IAM architecture strategies aligned with business and security objectives of our clients.

• Design scalable and secure identity solutions including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, Customer Identity and access management (CIAM), and privileged access management (PAM).

• Serve as the technical authority for IAM tools and platforms (e.g., Azure AD, ADFS, SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, CyberArk, Forgerock etc.)

• Lead the client project for integration of legacy and modern identity providers into a unified IAM framework

• Develop strong architecture principles and guidelines including scalability, resilience, modularity, and security-by-design

• Lead the deployment and configuration of IAM solutions for clients across cloud and on-premises environments

• Provide IAM integration designs and architectural guidelines for new applications and services, including APIs, SSO, and federation protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).

• Conduct review IAM systems for performance, availability, and security

• Drive the adoption of Authentication and Authorization reference architectures for existing, new and emerging IAM technologies

• Develop and enforce IAM policies, standards, and best practices.

• Help our client to achieve compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOX, HIPAA) and internal security policies.

• Participate in enterprise architecture governance and contribute to strategic planning.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

• 8+ years of experience in IAM architecture and implementation

• Proven experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint, ForgeRock, Okta, CyberArk, or similar.

• Strong understanding of directory services (Active Directory, LDAP), PKI, and identity federation.

• Understanding of cloud architectures and strategy (public, private, and hybrid).

• CISSP, CISM, or product vendor certifications is a plus

Technical Skills:
• Expertise in IAM protocols and standards (SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SCIM).

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid identity models.

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and modern security frameworks.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices is a plus.

Soft Skills:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

• Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional teams.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality

Potrai guidare attivamente lo sviluppo aziendale da opportunità di origine, proposte leader e convertirli in impegni di successo del cliente. - Sviluppare nuove idee e proposte da condividere con i clienti per garantire nuovi ed espandere i progetti esistenti. I progetti in genere includono: (i) strategia di qualità e QMS, modello operativo e design target-state, (ii) strategia regolamentare e progettazione del modello operativo (ad esempio per le presentazioni, le registrazioni, l'etichettatura, post-mercato / gestione del ciclo di vita), (iii) progettazione e realizzazione di nuove tecnologie e modi di lavoro, (iv) strategie digitali e roadmap funzionali - Copertura Qualità e Competenze funzionali regolabili in tutta la catena del valore. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri team di consulenza che coprono l'accesso commerciale, il mercato, la supply chain e altre funzioni. - Guidare la crescita e la trasformazione del nostro team di Qualità e Regolazione, capacità e consulenza aziendale. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con la rete globale di esperti di PwC e il nostro team AI aziendale per sviluppare e scalare nuove proposizioni, modelli di consegna e beni, sia per i nostri clienti che per come operiamo a PwC. - Sviluppare ed espandere attivamente la propria rete e rappresentare PwC nelle riunioni dei clienti, negli eventi del settore e nelle conferenze. - Lavorare in un ambiente in rapida crescita, che è guidato dal rispetto, dalla collegialità e dallo spirito di squadra forte (che vince come squadra, non come individuo).
• Requisiti - Hai più di 10 anni di esperienza di lavoro all'interno di Qualità e/o Regolazione, di cui almeno 6 anni di consulenza. - In consulenza, avrete lavorato o lavorerete in una società di consulenza manageriale, consigliando i clienti sulla strategia di Qualità e Regolazione, e avete esperienza nell'esecuzione di grandi progetti di trasformazione e nello sviluppo di nuove proposizioni e lavoro. - Nei ruoli del settore, sei stato esposto a molti dei passi chiave di miglioramento delle funzioni aziendali che operano lungo la catena del valore. - Come noleggio esperto, si dispone di un record di traccia solida sia nello sviluppo aziendale che nella fornitura di progetto: si originano e modellano opportunità, processi di proposta di piombo e convertirli con successo in impegni client. Si sfrutta una forte rete di settore personale con decisori lungo la catena del valore e sono appassionati di networking e la costruzione di relazioni cliente a lungo termine. - L'utente ha l'esposizione ad alcune delle seguenti aree: GxP e altri quadri normativi rilevanti, privacy/protezione dei dati, sviluppo della strategia digitale, progettazione del modello operativo, progettazione del sistema/miglioramento/manutenzione, miglioramento del processo, implementazione della tecnologia e tecnologie digitali e di analisi, tra cui AI e casi di utilizzo pratico nelle funzioni Qualità e Regolazione. Contatto Nessuna informazione di contatto fornita.
descriptionByLocale.en:
• Sell, lead and, together with the team, deliver high-impact projects engaging with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients. You will actively drive business development by originating opportunities, leading proposals and converting them into successful client engagements.

• Develop new ideas and propositions to share with clients to secure new and expand existing projects. The projects typically include: (i) Quality and QMS strategy, operating model and target‑state design, (ii) Regulatory strategy and operating model design (e.g. for submissions, registrations, labelling, post‑market / lifecycle management), (iii) Design and implementation of new technologies and ways of working, (iv) Digital strategies and functional roadmaps

• Cover Quality and Regulatory functional expertise across the value chain. You will also work closely with our consulting teams covering commercial, market access, supply chain and other functions.

• Drive the growth and transformation of our Quality and Regulatory team, capabilities and consulting business. You will work closely with PwC's global network of experts and our enterprise AI team to develop and scale new, AI‑enabled propositions, delivery models and assets – both for our clients and for how we operate at PwC.

• Actively build and expand your own network and represent PwC at client meetings, industry events and conferences.

• Work in a fast-growing environment, which is driven by respect, collegiality, and strong team spirit (winning as team, not as an individual).

• You have more than 10 years' experience working within Quality and/or Regulatory, of which at least 6 years in consulting.

• In consulting, you will have worked or are working in a management consulting firm, advising clients on Quality and Regulatory strategy, and you have experience in running large transformation projects and developing new propositions and work.

• In industry roles, you have been exposed to many of the key steps of improving business functions that operate along the value chain.

• As an experienced hire, you have a solid track record in both business development and project delivery: you originate and shape opportunities, lead proposal processes and successfully convert them into client engagements. You leverage a strong personal industry network with decision-makers along the value chain and are passionate about networking and building long-term client relationships.

• You have exposure to some of the following areas: GxP and other relevant regulatory frameworks, data privacy/protection, digital strategy development, operating model design, system design/improvement/maintenance, process improvement, technology implementation and digital and analytics technologies, including AI and practical use cases in Quality and Regulatory functions.

jobs.title: Manager in Audit Trade, Industries & Services - US GAAP
jobs.description:
Ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in financial audit? As a Senior Manager in our Financial Audit team, you'll join skilled professionals passionate about excellence and innovation. You'll lead and mentor teams in a dynamic, international environment, combining technical expertise with leadership skills. This role offers the chance to work with diverse clients, tackle complex audits, and shape the future of financial reporting. Together with your team, you'll create value, inspire trust, and drive meaningful change. If you're ready to grow as a leader, we want to hear from you.

• Audit Expertise: You will lead audits for clients in the engineering and manufacturing sector.

• Integrated Audits: You are responsible for integrated audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with United States Generally Accepted . Accounting Principles (US GAAP) and file with the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC).

• Statutory Audits: You are responsible for statutory audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with Swiss law.

• Private Company Audits: You are responsible for audits of private companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

• Non-Financial Reporting: You are responsible for managing audits of non-financial reports (e.g., ESG audits).

• Deliver Results: You are responsible for the preparation of the audit file for Partner review and assisting in the presentation of the audit findings to management or the Board of Directors.

• Client Relationships: You develop new and extend existing relationships with our clients and actively support the client in technical accounting matters.

• Own Your Development: You are in the driver's seat of your own responsibility, flexibility, and development.

• Experience: Currently Manager, you have more than 5 years of demonstrable experience in a Big 4 company.

• Technical Expertise: You are technically strong with an excellent working knowledge of US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, SOX, and PCAOB standards.

• Certification: You hold a US CPA qualification or an equivalent certification.

• Audit Management: You have experience in managing large, multi-location audits and are highly effective in your day-to-day management of clients and network PwC firms within the region.

• Relationship Building: You have experience in building and maintaining strong relationships with senior management at local, regional, and corporate levels.

• Team Player: You are a team player with the ability to report upwards to Partners.

• Communication Skills: You have excellent English verbal and written communication skills - French is a plus.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sei pronto a fare il prossimo passo nella tua carriera e avere un impatto nella revisione contabile finanziaria? Come Senior Manager nel nostro team di Revisione Contabile Finanziaria, ti unirai a professionisti esperti appassionati di eccellenza e innovazione. Guiderai e mentorerai team in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale, combinando competenze tecniche con abilità di leadership. Questo ruolo offre la possibilità di lavorare con clienti diversi, affrontare audit complessi e plasmare il futuro della rendicontazione finanziaria. Insieme al tuo team, creerai valore, ispirerai fiducia e guiderai un cambiamento significativo. Se sei pronto a crescere come leader, vogliamo sentirti. ## Mansioni - Competenza nella revisione: condurrai revisioni per clienti nel settore ingegneristico e manifatturiero. - Revisioni integrate: sarai responsabile delle revisioni integrate di società che preparano bilanci in conformità con i Principi Contabili Generalmente Accettati degli Stati Uniti (US GAAP) e presentano documenti alla Securities Exchange Commission (SEC). - Revisioni statutarie: sarai responsabile delle revisioni statutarie di società che preparano bilanci in conformità con la legge svizzera. - Revisioni di società private: sarai responsabile delle revisioni di società private che preparano bilanci in conformità con gli International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). - Rendicontazione non finanziaria: sarai responsabile della gestione delle revisioni di rapporti non finanziari (ad esempio, revisioni ESG). - Consegna dei risultati: sarai responsabile della preparazione del fascicolo di revisione per la revisione del Partner e di assistenza nella presentazione dei risultati della revisione alla gestione o al Consiglio di amministrazione. - Rapporti con i clienti: svilupperai nuovi rapporti e estenderai quelli esistenti con i nostri clienti e supporterai attivamente il cliente in questioni contabili tecniche. - Sviluppo personale: sei responsabile del tuo sviluppo, della tua responsabilità, flessibilità e crescita. ##
• Requisiti - Esperienza: attualmente Manager, hai più di 5 anni di esperienza dimostrabile in una società Big 4. - Competenza tecnica: sei tecnicamente forte con una conoscenza di lavoro eccellente degli US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, SOX e PCAOB. - Certificazione: possiedi una qualificazione US CPA o una certificazione equivalente. - Gestione della revisione: hai esperienza nella gestione di revisioni di grandi dimensioni e multi-location e sei molto efficace nella gestione quotidiana dei clienti e delle società della rete PwC all'interno della regione. - Costruzione di relazioni: hai esperienza nella costruzione e nel mantenimento di solide relazioni con la gestione senior a livello locale, regionale e aziendale. - Lavoro di squadra: sei un membro del team con la capacità di riferire ai Partner. - Abilità comunicative: hai eccellenti abilità comunicative verbali e scritte in inglese - il francese è un vantaggio. ## Contatto Nessuna informazione di contatto fornita.

Beschreibung Sind Sie bereit, den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere zu machen und einen Einfluss auf die Finanzprüfung auszuüben? Als Senior Manager in unserem Team für Finanzprüfungen werden Sie sich erfahrenen Fachleuten anschließen, die sich für Exzellenz und Innovation begeistern. Sie werden Teams in einer dynamischen, internationalen Umgebung führen und betreuen, indem Sie technische Expertise mit Führungsqualitäten kombinieren. Diese Rolle bietet die Chance, mit verschiedenen Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten, komplexe Prüfungen durchzuführen und die Zukunft der Finanzberichterstattung zu gestalten. Zusammen mit Ihrem Team werden Sie Wert schaffen, Vertrauen inspirieren und bedeutende Veränderungen vorantreiben. Wenn Sie bereit sind, als Führungskraft zu wachsen, möchten wir von Ihnen hören. ##
• Aufgaben - Prüfungskompetenz: Sie werden Prüfungen für Kunden im Ingenieur- und Fertigungssektor leiten. - Integrierte Prüfungen: Sie sind verantwortlich für integrierte Prüfungen von Unternehmen, die Finanzberichte gemäß den Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP) der Vereinigten Staaten erstellen und bei der Securities Exchange Commission (SEC) einreichen. - Statutarische Prüfungen: Sie sind verantwortlich für statutarische Prüfungen von Unternehmen, die Finanzberichte gemäß schweizerischem Recht erstellen. - Prüfungen von Privatunternehmen: Sie sind verantwortlich für Prüfungen von Privatunternehmen, die Finanzberichte gemäß den International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) erstellen. - Nichtfinanzielle Berichterstattung: Sie sind verantwortlich für die Verwaltung von Prüfungen nichtfinanzieller Berichte (z.B. ESG-Prüfungen). - Ergebnisse liefern: Sie sind verantwortlich für die Vorbereitung des Prüfungsordners für die Überprüfung durch den Partner und die Unterstützung bei der Präsentation der Prüfungsergebnisse an die Geschäftsführung oder den Verwaltungsrat. - Kundenbeziehungen: Sie entwickeln neue und bestehende Beziehungen mit unseren Kunden weiter und unterstützen den Kunden aktiv in technischen Rechnungslegungsfragen. - Eigene Entwicklung: Sie sind für Ihre eigene Verantwortung, Flexibilität und Entwicklung verantwortlich. ##
• Anforderungen - Erfahrung: derzeit Manager, mehr als 5 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer Big 4-Gesellschaft. - Technische Expertise: Sie sind technisch stark mit exzellenter Arbeitskenntnis der US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, SOX und PCAOB-Standards. - Zertifizierung: Sie besitzen eine US CPA-Qualifikation oder eine gleichwertige Zertifizierung. - Prüfungsgestion: Sie haben Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von großen, standortübergreifenden Prüfungen und sind sehr effektiv in der täglichen Verwaltung von Kunden und Netzwerk-PwC-Gesellschaften innerhalb der Region. - Beziehungsaufbau: Sie haben Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Aufrechterhaltung von starken Beziehungen zu Senior-Managern auf lokaler, regionaler und Unternehmensebene. - Teamplayer: Sie sind ein Teamplayer mit der Fähigkeit, an Partner zu berichten. - Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Sie haben exzellente verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch - Französisch ist ein Plus. ## Kontakt Keine Kontaktinformationen bereitgestellt.

jobs.title: Associate / Senior Associate - Cloud, Data and AI (Cloud & AI Engineer)
jobs.description:
Das Cloud, Data & AI Team bei PwC entwickelt KI-Systeme, die produktiv eingesetzt werden und langfristig bestehen bleiben. Im direkten Austausch mit Kunden gestalten, entwickeln und implementieren wir Generative AI-Anwendungen in Cloud-Umgebungen, um reale geschäftliche Herausforderungen maßgeblich zu lösen.

• Entwerfe und definiere Systemarchitekturen und wähle passende Technologien aus

• Steuere autonome Codier-Workflows: Lenk KI-Codieragenten zur Generierung, Prüfung und Verfeinerung von Code

• Entwickle Generative AI-Anwendungen von der Konzeptphase bis zur produktiven Bereitstellung

• Arbeite direkt mit Kund:innen zusammen, erkenne Geschäftsanforderungen und liefere technische Lösungen

• Setze KI-Lösungen in der Cloud um, vorzugsweise auf Azure, alternativ auf GCP oder AWS

• Gestalte und betreibe Datenarchitekturen, inklusive Datenpipelines und Vektordatenbanken

• Sorge für stringente technische Disziplin mit Testing, Code Reviews, CI/CD und Monitoring

jobs.title: Audit Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Trade, Industries & Services / US GAAP
jobs.description:
In the field of auditing, we provide independent and objective assurance that records, statements, and financial processes are accurate, reliable, and compliant, in order to instill stakeholder confidence. We therefore contribute to the integrity of financial systems, facilitate informed decision-making, protect against fraud, and promote trust in the business environment.

• Support the engagement manager in planning, executing, and finalizing group and local audits across various non-financial services industries.

• Draft audit reports and recommendations.

• Review the content of mandatory ESG information, including country-specific reports, and provide advice on areas for improvement.

• Acquire in-depth knowledge of a wide range of clients.

• Coordinate a network of international teams on your engagements.

• Join an active and diverse team in a rapidly growing sector.

• A university degree in accounting or a related field, with a US CPA (or a comparable certification) completed or in progress.

• Holder of, or about to obtain, a Chartered Accountant diploma or another similar qualification (DEC, ACCA, etc.).

• 3 to 5 years of recent experience in a public accounting firm, with solid expertise in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB, and SOX.

• Highly motivated and passionate about sustainability, climate-related issues, and associated regulations.

• Fluent in English, French a plus

• Enjoy working in a team and interacting with clients.

• Possess excellent analytical and synthesis skills.

jobs.title: Manager - Cloud, Data & AI (Cloud & Data Platform Architect)
jobs.description:
As a Manager in the Cloud, Data & AI team, you will contribute with your expertise around Microsoft technologies (Azure and Data Platforms), their interplay in ecosystems involving multi-vendor tools and applications (such as Master Data Management, BI, Analytics, AI, etc.) and data architecture knowledge and experience.

• Analyze, design and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of entire systems.

• Consult clients on their data architecture and provide an analysis of efficiency, integration, cost, feasibility and technical dimensions.

• Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.

• Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.

• Continuously develop skills outside your skill set and stay up to date with new technologies and market demand.

• Effectively mentor others, using work reviews as opportunities to deepen team members' expertise.

• Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.

• Coach and upskill your team mates to ensure the team growth and long-term success

• Solid knowledge and proven experience with Azure and Microsoft technology stack (e.g., Fabric), supported by advanced-level certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator, Solution Architect, Fabric Engineer, etc.).

• Microsoft certification acquired, either AZ-305 or DP-600/DP-700

• Leadership and team development

• Expertise in Azure and Microsoft technologies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• A university degree in fields such as business informatics, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any engineering discipline is preferred..

• Over 7 years of work experience focusing on data engineering, analytics, or data science, with consulting experience being a plus.

• Experience in sourcing, preparing, and delivering end-to-end data architecture or platform solutions to internal or external clients.

• Excellent communication skills with proficiency in English. German proficiency is preferred, but not required

jobs.title: Audit Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Trade, Industries & Services / US GAAP
jobs.description:
In our Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS) practice, we don't just analyze numbers; we uncover insights that help businesses grow, adapt, and succeed in a rapidly changing world. We work with a diverse range of clients, from global corporations to dynamic local businesses, helping them navigate through challenges, seize opportunities, and build a sustainable future.

By combining our unique perspectives and leveraging advanced technology, we're shaping the future of auditing and the industries we serve. Every project is an opportunity to grow, make an impact, and contribute to building trust in society.

• Take ownership of planning, executing, and completing group and local audits across a variety of non-financial services industries, with a focus on US GAAP and SOX testing.

• Perform SOX internal controls testing in compliance with the latest PCAOB guidance, demonstrating your expertise in internal controls for US-listed groups as well as their significant subsidiaries based in Switzerland.

• Collaborate with international teams and clients, fostering strong relationships and ensuring seamless communication across borders.

• Drive the integration of our remote team members, ensuring they are part of our local engagement team.

• Leverage digital tools, data analysis software, and automation solutions to structure, visualize, and present actionable insights that add value for clients.

• Embrace new challenges and opportunities to grow, developing your leadership skills and contributing to the success of your team and clients.

• A university degree in accounting or a related field, with a US CPA (or a comparable certification) completed or in progress.

• 3-5 years of recent experience in a public accounting firm, with solid expertise in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB, and SOX.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and develop tailored solutions for clients.

• Proficiency in English; knowledge of German, French, or Italian is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, foster client relationships, and manage expectations.

Why Join Us?
We understand that your career is more than just a job - it's a journey. That's why we're committed to supporting you every step of the way:

• Professional Growth: Access tailored learning opportunities, mentorship, and financial support for further certifications.

• Professional Growth

• Flexibility: Work arrangements that help you balance your professional and personal life.

• Flexibility

• Inclusive Culture: A diverse and collaborative environment where your unique perspective is valued.

• Inclusive Culture

• Innovative Tools: Leverage advanced technology and creative approaches to redefine the future of auditing.

• Innovative Tools

• Purpose-Driven Work: Contribute to meaningful projects that make a difference for our clients, society, and the planet.

• Purpose-Driven WorkReady to make an impact?
Join our community of solvers and help us shape the future of auditing - digital, sustainable, and global. Apply now!

descriptionByLocale.it: Nella nostra practice Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS), non ci limitiamo ad analizzare i numeri; scopriamo intuizioni che aiutano le aziende a crescere, adattarsi e avere successo in un mondo in rapida evoluzione. Lavoriamo con una vasta gamma di clienti, da grandi corporation globali a dinamiche imprese locali, aiutandoli ad affrontare le sfide, cogliere le opportunità e costruire un futuro sostenibile. Combinando le nostre prospettive uniche e sfruttando la tecnologia avanzata, stiamo plasmando il futuro dell'audit e dei settori che serviamo. Ogni progetto è un'opportunità per crescere, fare la differenza e contribuire a costruire fiducia nella società. Assumersi la responsabilità della pianificazione, dell'esecuzione e del completamento degli audit di gruppo e locali in una varietà di settori di servizi non finanziari, con un focus su US GAAP e test SOX. Eseguire il testing dei controlli interni SOX in conformità con le ultime linee guida PCAOB, dimostrando la propria competenza nei controlli interni per i gruppi quotati negli USA e per le loro filiali significative con sede in Svizzera. Collaborare con team internazionali e clienti, favorendo solide relazioni e garantendo una comunicazione fluida oltre confine. Promuovere l'integrazione dei membri remoti del team, assicurandosi che facciano parte del team di incarico locale. Sfruttare strumenti digitali, software di analisi dei dati e soluzioni di automazione per strutturare, visualizzare e presentare informazioni operative che aggiungano valore per i clienti. Abbracciare nuove sfide e opportunità di crescita, sviluppando le proprie capacità di leadership e contribuendo al successo del team e dei clienti. Laurea universitaria in contabilità o in un campo correlato, con US CPA (o certificazione comparabile) completata o in corso. 3-5 anni di recente esperienza in uno studio di contabilità pubblica, con solida competenza in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB e SOX. Solide capacità analitiche e di pensiero critico, con la capacità di interpretare dati finanziari complessi e sviluppare soluzioni su misura per i clienti. Padronanza dell'inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco, del francese o dell'italiano è un vantaggio. Eccellenti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team internazionali, coltivare le relazioni con i clienti e gestire le aspettative. Perché unirsi a noi? Sappiamo che la tua carriera è molto più di un semplice lavoro — è un percorso. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a supportarti in ogni passo del cammino: Crescita professionale: accesso a opportunità di apprendimento personalizzate, mentoring e supporto finanziario per ulteriori certificazioni. Flessibilità: modalità di lavoro che ti aiutano a bilanciare vita professionale e personale. Cultura inclusiva: un ambiente diversificato e collaborativo dove la tua prospettiva unica è valorizzata. Strumenti innovativi: sfrutta la tecnologia avanzata e approcci creativi per ridefinire il futuro dell'audit. Lavoro orientato allo scopo: contribuisci a progetti significativi che fanno la differenza per i nostri clienti, la società e il pianeta. Pronto/a a fare la differenza? Unisciti alla nostra community of solvers e aiutaci a plasmare il futuro dell'audit - digitale, sostenibile e globale. Candidati ora!

descriptionByLocale.de: In unserer Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS) Praxis analysieren wir nicht nur Zahlen; wir gewinnen Erkenntnisse, die Unternehmen helfen, in einer sich schnell verändernden Welt zu wachsen, sich anzupassen und erfolgreich zu sein. Wir arbeiten mit einem breiten Spektrum an Kunden zusammen, von globalen Konzernen bis hin zu dynamischen lokalen Unternehmen, und helfen ihnen, Herausforderungen zu meistern, Chancen zu nutzen und eine nachhaltige Zukunft aufzubauen. Durch die Verbindung unserer einzigartigen Perspektiven und den Einsatz modernster Technologie gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung und der Branchen, denen wir dienen. Jedes Projekt ist eine Gelegenheit zu wachsen, Wirkung zu erzielen und zum Aufbau von Vertrauen in der Gesellschaft beizutragen. Übernimm die Verantwortung für die Planung, Durchführung und den Abschluss von Konzern- und Einzelabschlussprüfungen in verschiedenen Nicht-Finanzdienstleistungsbranchen, mit Fokus auf US GAAP und SOX-Tests. Führe SOX-Tests interner Kontrollen in Übereinstimmung mit den neuesten PCAOB-Richtlinien durch und demonstriere deine Expertise in internen Kontrollen für in den USA börsennotierte Konzerne sowie deren wesentliche Tochtergesellschaften in der Schweiz. Arbeite mit internationalen Teams und Kunden zusammen, fördere starke Beziehungen und stelle eine reibungslose Kommunikation über Grenzen hinweg sicher. Fördere die Integration unserer Remote-Teammitglieder und stelle sicher, dass sie Teil unseres lokalen Engagement-Teams sind. Nutze digitale Tools, Datenanalysesoftware und Automatisierungslösungen, um handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse zu strukturieren, zu visualisieren und zu präsentieren, die für Kunden einen Mehrwert schaffen. Nimm neue Herausforderungen und Wachstumschancen an, entwickle deine Führungsqualitäten und trage zum Erfolg deines Teams und deiner Kunden bei. Ein Hochschulabschluss in Buchhaltung oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet, mit einem abgeschlossenen oder in Bearbeitung befindlichen US CPA (oder einer vergleichbaren Zertifizierung). 3–5 Jahre aktuelle Erfahrung in einer Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, mit fundierten Kenntnissen in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB und SOX. Starke analytische und kritische Denkfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten zu interpretieren und massgeschneiderte Lösungen für Kunden zu entwickeln. Fliessende Englischkenntnisse; Kenntnisse in Deutsch, Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Vorteil. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit internationalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, Kundenbeziehungen zu pflegen und Erwartungen zu managen. Warum uns beitreten? Wir verstehen, dass deine Karriere mehr als nur ein Job ist – es ist eine Reise. Deshalb sind wir darauf ausgerichtet, dich auf jedem Schritt des Weges zu unterstützen: Berufliches Wachstum: Zugang zu massgeschneiderten Lernmöglichkeiten, Mentoring und finanzieller Unterstützung für weitere Zertifizierungen. Flexibilität: Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die dir helfen, dein Berufs- und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen. Inklusive Kultur: Eine vielfältige und kollaborative Umgebung, in der deine einzigartige Perspektive geschätzt wird. Innovative Tools: Nutzung modernster Technologie und kreativer Ansätze zur Neugestaltung der Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Beitrag zu bedeutungsvollen Projekten, die für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und den Planeten einen Unterschied machen. Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers und hilf uns, die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jetzt bewerben!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Au sein de notre pratique Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS), nous ne nous contentons pas d'analyser des chiffres ; nous mettons en lumière des insights qui aident les entreprises à croître, à s'adapter et à réussir dans un monde en rapide évolution. Nous travaillons avec un large éventail de clients, des grandes multinationales aux entreprises locales dynamiques, en les aidant à naviguer dans les défis, à saisir les opportunités et à bâtir un avenir durable. En combinant nos perspectives uniques et en tirant parti des technologies avancées, nous façonnons l'avenir de l'audit et des secteurs que nous servons. Chaque projet est une occasion de grandir, d'avoir un impact et de contribuer à instaurer la confiance dans la société. Prenez en charge la planification, l'exécution et la finalisation des audits de groupe et locaux dans divers secteurs hors services financiers, en mettant l'accent sur les tests US GAAP et SOX. Effectuez des tests de contrôles internes SOX conformément aux dernières directives du PCAOB, en démontrant votre expertise en matière de contrôles internes pour les groupes cotés aux États-Unis ainsi que leurs filiales importantes basées en Suisse. Collaborez avec des équipes et des clients internationaux, en favorisant des relations solides et en assurant une communication fluide par-delà les frontières. Favorisez l'intégration de nos membres d'équipe à distance, en veillant à ce qu'ils fassent partie de notre équipe d'engagement locale. Tirez parti des outils numériques, des logiciels d'analyse de données et des solutions d'automatisation pour structurer, visualiser et présenter des insights exploitables qui apportent de la valeur aux clients. jobs.title: Associate - Payroll Consulting 80-100%
jobs.description:
• Führe die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung auf Mandatsbasis aus und berücksichtige dabei alle geltenden Vorschriften und Gesetze.

• Erstelle die Quellensteuer- und Sozialversicherungs-Deklarationen sowie die Lohnausweise.

• Sei die erste Ansprechperson für Kund:innen unterschiedlicher Grössen und Branchen - von kleineren KMU's bis hin zu grösseren Niederlassungen von international tätigen Unternehmen.

• Unterstütze Kund:innen bei ihrer Personaladministration und informiere sie proaktiv über fachliche Neuerungen.

• Pflege den Kontakt zu Kund:innen, Sozialversicherungsbehörden und Quellensteuer-Ämtern.

• Unterstütze bei der Abrechnung von Expatriates und erstelle die Shadow-Payroll.

• Abstimmungen zwischen PK-Rechnungen, Finanzbuchhaltung und Lohnbuchhaltung.

• Verfüge über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Treuhand.

• Bringe mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Lohnbuchhaltung mit und kenne dich mit personaladministrativen Aufgaben aus.

• Vertiefe dein Know-how im Bereich Lohn/Sozialversicherungen und verfolge eine Weiterbildung zur Payroll Spezialist;in, eidg. Fachausweis als HR- oder Sozialversicherungs-Fachmann/-frau als dein langfristiges Ziel.

• Stilsicher in Deutsch und verfüge über sehr gute Englisch-Kenntnisse.

• Verfüge über gute Kenntnisse in SAP oder im Abacus-Lohnmodul und habe gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

• Arbeite genau und effizient und habe Interesse daran, dein Wissen ständig auszubauen.

• Sei motiviert in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten und setze dein Wissen im Lohnbereich gerne als Berater:in für unsere Kund:innen und deren interessanten Anfragen ein.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager Transaction Services
jobs.description:
In Transaction Services you will be at the forefront of our client's M&A activity and lead projects and multidisciplinary, first in class teams.
We are looking for a motivated team player who can help us deliver outstanding client projects and advance our team. A career within the Deals Transaction Services team will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value with their M&A activities. We focus on evaluating M&A projects in due diligence, pre and post completion. We conduct pre deal and confirmatory due diligence, execute large-scale enterprise wide integrations, and support complex divestitures and separations on a wide range of areas.

• Help our clients with dedicated support for transactions in a wide variety of industries and circumstances (acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures & structured investments).

• Work across the areas of buy-side due diligence, sell-side assistance and vendor due diligence, deal and negotiation support for both corporate and private equity clients.

• Collaborate with other experts to develop a rapid understanding of the client's business and issues, and articulate your findings appropriately in order to deliver high quality reports.

• Work in a diversified, international environment covering multiple areas and industries.

• Team up with a network of highly talented and knowledgeable experts.

• Bachelor's or master's degree and have a background in finance (CPA or CFA).

• Thorough understanding of financial accounting and reporting requirements in accordance with internationally recognized reporting standards (e.g. IFRS, US GAAP).

• At least 5 years of experience in providing financial due diligence and other transaction-related services to large companies and private equity fund clients.

• Fluent in English, any other language is a plus.

• You are energetic, proactive, able to empathise with clients and staff, and are enthusiastic about delivering value to clients.

• Flexible and demonstrate willingness to conduct business travel for client assignments or business-related matters.

• Excellent analytical skills and are experienced in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and additional analytical software tools (e.g. PowerBI, Alteryx) to analyse and present data in a meaningful and efficient way.

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Manager Financial Services Consulting - Liquidity & Funding
jobs.description:
• Join PwC Advisory to become part of our Strategy & Transformation Banking Team in Zurich.

• Be part of our L&F Team and help our banking clients to transform their liquidity and funding practices to improve their opportunity cost efficiency and to fulfil internal and external requirements, while closely collaborating with Finance, Banking Restructuring and Risk Teams.

• BE responsible to further develop the go-to-market strategy for liquidity and funding and manage projects with our key banking clients.

• Developi solutions that will help our clients to efficiently measure, manage and use their liquid assets on a short-term operational and mid-term structural basis and integrate that view into their risk understanding in a rising interest rate environment.

• Continuously further develop the service offering for the liquidity and funding practice and provide thought leadership to the banking sector.

• Be part of a team that operates strongly in an interdisciplinary environment within PwC. You will be using and building bridges to our fellow teams that work at the technological edge in big data analysis and artificial intelligence.

• Work in a global environment with the largest banks, you will be embedded in a network of our company that gathers and shares industry insights in Liquidity & Funding worldwide.

• An excellent University / ETH Master's degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or an adjacent field that enables you to work with banks and other financial service companies.

• A strong affinity for numbers and logical processes, are excellent with Excel and other quantitative programs and feel highly comfortable showing your ideas in Power Point.

• Take responsibility for constantly increasing your knowledge in Banking on a personal, intrinsic basis throughout your career.

• More than 3 years (SA) / 5 years (M) of hands-on experience in the Banking Sector or Consulting and have gathered extensive experience working on liquidity and funding topics incl. Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and working with Trading, Treasury Departments, Financial Risk or Finance and Accounting Departments.

• Extensive experience with complex banking products.

• Fluent in English. German is a highly significant plus and other languages (e.g. French) are welcome.

• Willing to travel to our client's international locations if required but are not disappointed if you are not needed to leave Zurich at all for a given time.

• Programming skills are highly recommended and beneficial (e.g. python).

• CFA, FRM certificates are a significant plus.

descriptionByLocale.it: Entra in PwC Advisory per far parte del nostro team Strategy & Transformation Banking a Zurigo. Fai parte del nostro team L&F e aiuta i nostri clienti bancari a trasformare le loro pratiche di liquidità e funding per migliorare l'efficienza dei costi opportunità e soddisfare i requisiti interni ed esterni, collaborando strettamente con i team Finance, Banking Restructuring e Risk. Sii responsabile dell'ulteriore sviluppo della go-to-market strategy per la liquidità e il funding e della gestione di progetti con i nostri principali clienti bancari. Sviluppa soluzioni che aiutino i clienti a misurare, gestire e utilizzare efficacemente le loro attività liquide su base operativa a breve termine e strutturale a medio termine, integrando questa visione nella loro comprensione del rischio in un contesto di tassi d'interesse in aumento. Developpa continuamente l'offerta di servizi per la practice liquidità e funding e fornisci thought leadership al settore bancario. Fai parte di un team che opera in un ambiente fortemente interdisciplinare all'interno di PwC. Utilizzerai e costruirai ponti con i team colleghi che lavorano all'avanguardia tecnologica nell'analisi dei big data e nell'intelligenza artificiale. Lavora in un contesto globale con le maggiori banche; sarai inserito in una rete della nostra azienda che raccoglie e condivide le conoscenze di settore in materia di Liquidity & Funding in tutto il mondo. • Requisiti: Eccellente laurea magistrale universitaria / ETH in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business Administration o in un campo affine che ti permetta di lavorare con banche e altre società di servizi finanziari. Forte affinità con i numeri e i processi logici, eccellenti capacità in Excel e altri programmi quantitativi, e grande facilità nel presentare le tue idee in Power Point. Assumi la responsabilità di accrescere continuamente le tue conoscenze nel settore bancario su base personale e intrinseca nel corso della tua carriera. Oltre 3 anni (SA) / 5 anni (M) di esperienza pratica nel settore bancario o nella consulenza, con un'ampia esperienza nei temi di liquidità e funding, inclusi Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), e nel lavoro con reparti Trading, Treasury, Financial Risk o Finance e Accounting. jobs.title: Senior Associate - Cybersecurity & Privacy
jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join our Cybersecurity & Privacy team, a multidisciplinary group of consultants, engineers, and risk specialists who help clients build digital trust, manage cyber risk, and comply with evolving regulations.

You will benefit from PwC's global network, proven methodologies, and a culture that values inclusion, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

Expect a collaborative environment where you can take ownership of workstreams, coach junior team members, and contribute to thought leadership while developing your expertise through engagements, training, and certifications.

• Deliver client engagements focused on cyber risk and privacy, including assessments, gap analyses, roadmaps, and implementation projects.

• Translate technical and regulatory requirements into pragmatic policies, standards, architectures, and operating procedures tailored to the client's risk appetite.

• Design and implement security controls aligned to frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and industry regulations (e.g., FINMA circulars, DORA, NIS2).

• Support clients in maturing capabilities across cloud security, identity and access management, data security (encryption, DLP), vulnerability and threat management, security monitoring, and incident response.

• Assess third-party and supply chain cyber risk, define remediation plans, and help establish continuous assurance and vendor oversight processes.

• Advise on privacy compliance and operations (e.g., GDPR, Swiss nFADP), including data protection impact assessments, records of processing activities, data subject rights, cross border transfers, and privacy-by-design.

• Lead workstreams, manage stakeholders, and ensure high-quality deliverables: reports, playbooks, risk registers, control matrices, and board-ready presentations.

• Contribute to business development: shape proposals, respond to RFPs, build repeatable assets, and develop points of view on emerging topics.

• Coach and mentor junior colleagues, foster a culture of teaming and excellence, and stay current with threat trends and regulatory developments.

• 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity and/or privacy consulting or a similar role (internal or external), with proven delivery of client-facing projects.- Strong knowledge of key frameworks and regulations: ISO/IEC 27001/2, NIST CSF, CIS Controls; awareness of NIS2, CRA, DORA, GDPR, Swiss nFADP and sector-specific guidance (e.g., FINMA) is a plus.

• Practical experience in several of the following: security governance and risk; privacy operations; identity and access management; data security; compliance with cybersecurity and resilience regulations; threat and vulnerability management; security operations and incident response; cloud security.

• Consulting core skills: structured problem-solving, clear writing, confident presentation, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex topics into actionable recommendations.

• Education in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Law, Business) or equivalent practical experience.

• Professional certifications are advantageous (e.g., SSCP, Security+).

• Language skills: fluent in English; French is a strong asset.

Descrizione Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per unire il nostro team Cybersecurity & Privacy, un gruppo multidisciplinare di consulenti, ingegneri e specialisti del rischio che aiutano i clienti a costruire la fiducia digitale, gestire il rischio informatico e rispettare le normative in evoluzione. Potrai beneficiare della rete globale di PwC, metodologie collaudate e una cultura che valorizza l'inclusione, l'apprendimento continuo e l'innovazione pratica. Aspettatevi un ambiente collaborativo in cui è possibile prendere la proprietà dei flussi di lavoro, dei membri del team di coach junior e contribuire alla leadership di pensiero, sviluppando le vostre competenze attraverso impegni, formazione e certificazioni. ## Mansioni - Fornire gli impegni dei clienti focalizzati sul rischio informatico e sulla privacy, tra cui valutazioni, analisi del gap, roadmap e progetti di implementazione. - Tradurre requisiti tecnici e normativi in politiche pragmatiche, standard, architetture e procedure operative su misura per l'appetito di rischio del cliente. - Progettare e implementare i controlli di sicurezza allineati a strutture come ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e normative del settore (ad esempio, FINMA circolari, DORA, NIS2). - Sostenere i client nella maturazione delle capacità attraverso la sicurezza cloud, l'identità e la gestione degli accessi, la sicurezza dei dati (crittografia, DLP), la vulnerabilità e la gestione delle minacce, il monitoraggio della sicurezza e la risposta agli incidenti. - Valutare il rischio informatico di terze parti e supply chain, definire piani di bonifica, e contribuire a stabilire processi di supervisione continua di garanzia e fornitore. - Consulenza sulla conformità e sulle operazioni della privacy (ad esempio, GDPR, Swiss nFADP), comprese le valutazioni d'impatto sulla protezione dei dati, i record delle attività di trattamento, i diritti dell'interessato, i trasferimenti transfrontalieri e la privacy-by-design. - Lead workstreams, gestire le parti interessate e garantire consegne di alta qualità: report, playbook, registri di rischio, matrici di controllo e presentazioni di bordo. - Contribuire allo sviluppo aziendale: formulare proposte, rispondere a RFP, costruire attività ripetibili e sviluppare punti di vista su argomenti emergenti. - Coach e mentore colleghi junior, promuovere una cultura del teaming e dell'eccellenza, e rimanere attuali con le tendenze delle minacce e gli sviluppi normativi. ##
• Requisiti - 2–5 anni di esperienza nella consulenza sulla sicurezza informatica e/o sulla privacy o un ruolo simile (internal o esterno), con comprovata consegna di progetti di customer-facing. - Una solida conoscenza dei quadri e dei regolamenti chiave: ISO/IEC 27001/2, NIST CSF, CIS Controls; la consapevolezza di NIS2, CRA, DORA, GDPR, Swiss nFADP e di orientamento settoriale (ad esempio, FINMA) è un vantaggio. - Esperienza pratica in diversi dei seguenti punti: governance della sicurezza e rischio; operazioni sulla privacy; gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso; sicurezza dei dati; conformità alle normative sulla sicurezza informatica e resilienza; gestione delle minacce e delle vulnerabilità; operazioni di sicurezza e risposta agli incidenti; sicurezza del cloud. - Consulenza competenze di base: strutturato problem-solving, scrittura chiara, presentazione sicura, gestione degli stakeholder, e la capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in raccomandazioni attuabili. - Istruzione in un campo rilevante (ad esempio, Informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, ingegneria, diritto, affari) o esperienza pratica equivalente. - Le certificazioni professionali sono vantaggiose (ad esempio, SSCP, Security+). - Capacità linguistiche: fluente in inglese; il francese è un bene forte. # Cosa # Nessun beneficio specifico elencato. ## Contatto Nessun dato di contatto specifico fornito.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione
• Stiamo cercando un responsabile fiscale degli Stati Uniti altamente qualificato per guidare e gestire complessi impegni fiscali per i nostri clienti privati. In questo ruolo, potrete sfruttare la vostra comprensione completa delle normative fiscali degli Stati Uniti e della pianificazione finanziaria per fornire servizi strategici di pianificazione fiscale e di conformità su misura per gli individui ad alto valore di rete. La vostra capacità di interpretare i dati fiscali complessi sarà essenziale nella navigazione del paesaggio fiscale in continua evoluzione per i nostri clienti. In questo ruolo, si: - costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti privati, comprendere le loro esigenze finanziarie uniche e fornire soluzioni fiscali su misura. - Sviluppare e implementare strategie di pianificazione fiscale che si allineano con gli obiettivi del cliente e gli standard del settore, massimizzando le efficienze fiscali per gli individui ad alto valore di rete. - supervisionare la preparazione e la revisione dei rendimenti fiscali complessi, garantendo il rispetto delle normative fiscali degli Stati Uniti e degli standard interni. - Fornire una guida esperta su questioni fiscali complesse, sfruttando la conoscenza approfondita delle normative fiscali degli Stati Uniti e la loro applicazione agli scenari dei clienti privati. - Interpretare e analizzare i dati fiscali per generare report e raccomandazioni intuitivi, aiutare i clienti a prendere decisioni finanziarie informate. ##
• Requisiti - Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza fiscale degli Stati Uniti con una società di contabilità internazionale o simile, specializzata nella conformità degli Stati Uniti e la consultazione di questioni fiscali per gli individui ad alto valore di rete. - Una laurea con una specializzazione in contabilità/tassazione o una laurea in giurisprudenza presso un'università accreditata. - CPA o IRS Iscritti. - Ampia competenza tecnica pertinente ai clienti privati, accoppiata con un record di successo nell'individuazione delle esigenze dei clienti e nel perseguire nuove opportunità di servizio. - Provata esperienza di leadership, tra cui stabilire la direzione, motivare i membri del team e promuovere l'innovazione. - Dimostrato successo nella generazione di nuove proposte di business, scrittura e collaborazione tra impegni e business unit. - Conoscenza avanzata del software di conformità fiscale e competenza in Microsoft Word, Excel e PowerPoint.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a highly skilled U.S. Tax Manager to lead and manage complex tax engagements for our private clients. In this role, you will leverage your comprehensive understanding of U.S. tax regulations and financial planning to provide strategic tax planning and compliance services tailored to high-net-worth individuals. Your ability to interpret complex tax data will be essential in navigating the ever-evolving tax landscape for our clients.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with private clients, understanding their unique financial needs and delivering tailored tax solutions.

• Develop and implement tax planning strategies that align with client objectives and industry standards, maximizing tax efficiencies for high-net-worth individuals.

• Oversee the preparation and review of complex tax returns, ensuring compliance with U.S. tax regulations and internal standards.

• Provide expert guidance on complex tax issues, leveraging your in-depth knowledge of U.S. tax regulations and their application to private client scenarios.

• Interpret and analyze tax data to generate insightful reports and recommendations, assisting clients in making informed financial decisions.

• A minimum of 5 years of U.S. taxation experience with an international accounting firm or similar, specializing in U.S. compliance and consulting tax issues for high-net-worth individuals.

• A bachelor's degree with a specialization in accounting/taxation or a law degree from an accredited university.

• CPA or IRS Enrolled Agent qualification.

• Extensive technical skills relevant to private clients, coupled with a successful track record in identifying client needs and pursuing new service opportunities.

• Proven leadership experience, including establishing direction, motivating team members, and fostering innovation.

• Demonstrated success in generating new business, writing proposals, and collaborating across engagements and business units.

• Advanced knowledge of tax compliance software and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten US-Steuermanager, um komplexe Steuerengagements für unsere Privatkunden zu führen und zu verwalten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Ihr umfassendes Verständnis der US-Steuervorschriften und Finanzplanung nutzen, um strategische Steuerplanungs- und Compliance-Dienste für hochleistungsfähige Personen zu bieten. Ihre Fähigkeit, komplexe Steuerdaten zu interpretieren, wird wesentlich sein, um die ständig wachsende Steuerlandschaft für unsere Kunden zu navigieren. In dieser Rolle werden Sie: - Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu Privatkunden, Verständnis ihrer einzigartigen finanziellen Bedürfnisse und Bereitstellung maßgeschneiderter Steuerlösungen. - Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Steuerplanungsstrategien, die sich mit Kundenzielen und Industriestandards ausrichten, indem die Steuereffizienzen für hochleistungsfähige Personen maximiert werden. - Überprüfen Sie die Vorbereitung und Überprüfung komplexer Steuererklärungen, um die Einhaltung der US-Steuervorschriften und der internen Standards zu gewährleisten. - Bieten Sie eine kompetente Beratung zu komplexen Steuerproblemen und nutzen Sie Ihr fundiertes Wissen über die US-Steuervorschriften und ihre Anwendung auf Privatkundenszenarien. - Dolmetschen und analysieren Sie Steuerdaten, um fundierte Berichte und Empfehlungen zu erstellen und Kunden dabei zu unterstützen, fundierte finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Requisiti - Mindestens 5 Jahre U.S. Besteuerungserfahrung mit einem internationalen Rechnungslegungsunternehmen oder ähnlichem, spezialisiert auf US-Konformitäts- und Beratungssteuerfragen für leistungsfähige Personen. - Ein Bachelor-Abschluss mit einer Spezialisierung in Buchhaltung/Steuerung oder einem Rechtsabschluss von einer akkreditierten Universität. - CPA oder IRS Eingeschriebene Agentenqualifikation. - Umfangreiche technische Fähigkeiten, die für Privatkunden relevant sind, sowie eine erfolgreiche Erfolgsbilanz bei der Identifizierung der Kundenbedürfnisse und der Verfolgung neuer Servicemöglichkeiten. - Bewährte Führungserfahrung, einschließlich der Ausrichtung, motivierende Teammitglieder und der Förderung von Innovation. - Erprobter Erfolg bei der Generierung von neuen Geschäften, schriftlichen Vorschlägen und der Zusammenarbeit über Engagements und Geschäftsbereiche. - Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der Steuer-Compliance-Software und der Kenntnisse in Microsoft Word, Excel und PowerPoint.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Nous recherchons un gestionnaire fiscal américain hautement qualifié pour diriger et gérer des engagements fiscaux complexes pour nos clients privés. Dans ce rôle, vous tirerez parti de votre compréhension approfondie de la réglementation fiscale et de la planification financière des États-Unis pour fournir des services de planification et de conformité fiscales stratégiques adaptés aux personnes de grande valeur. Votre capacité à interpréter des données fiscales complexes sera essentielle pour naviguer dans le paysage fiscal en constante évolution pour nos clients. Dans ce rôle, vous : - établir et maintenir de solides relations avec des clients privés, comprendre leurs besoins financiers uniques et fournir des solutions fiscales adaptées. - Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de planification fiscale qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs des clients et les normes de l'industrie et qui maximisent l'efficacité fiscale pour les particuliers à forte valeur nette. - Superviser la préparation et l'examen de déclarations de revenus complexes, en veillant au respect de la réglementation fiscale américaine et des normes internes. - Fournir des conseils spécialisés sur des questions fiscales complexes, en tirant parti de votre connaissance approfondie de la réglementation fiscale américaine et de son application aux scénarios de clients privés. - Interpréter et analyser les données fiscales pour produire des rapports et des recommandations éclairés, aidant les clients à prendre des décisions financières éclairées. ##
• Requisiti - Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en fiscalité aux États-Unis avec une firme de comptabilité internationale ou similaire, spécialisée dans les questions de conformité aux États-Unis et de consultation fiscale pour les particuliers à forte valeur nette. - Baccalauréat spécialisé en comptabilité/imposition ou diplôme en droit d'une université agréée. - Qualification de CPA ou IRS en tant qu'agent inscrit. - De vastes compétences techniques pertinentes pour les clients privés, associées à une expérience réussie dans l'identification des besoins des clients et la recherche de nouvelles possibilités de service. - Expérience de leadership éprouvée, y compris l'établissement de l'orientation, la motivation des membres de l'équipe et la promotion de l'innovation. - Le succès démontré dans la création de nouvelles entreprises, la rédaction de propositions et la collaboration entre les groupes d'engagements et d'affaires. - Connaissance avancée du logiciel de conformité fiscale et de la compétence en Microsoft Word, Excel et PowerPoint.

jobs.description:
Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Bei PwC im Bereich Audit - Financial Services (Versicherungen) analysierst du Unternehmen: Wie erfolgreich sind sie? Wo liegen Chancen und Risiken? Wie können sie nachhaltiger werden?

Hier arbeitest du mit neugierigen und ambitionierten Menschen, um die Wirtschaft von morgen zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen.

Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Deine Perspektive zählt, und wir unterstützen dich, deine Ziele zu erreichen.

Du willst nicht einfach nur einen Job, sondern etwas bewirken? Willkommen bei PwC! Hier kannst du:
• Unternehmen verstehen und transformieren: Prüfe Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse und stelle sicher, dass diese den regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen - vor Ort, im Office oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

• Digital die Zukunft gestalten: Nutze modernste Tools, KI und Datenanalyse, um die Wirtschaftsprüfung auf ein neues Level zu heben. Deine Ideen zählen!

• Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben: Unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ESG-Berichten und begleite Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Umweltbewusstsein und sozialer Verantwortung.

• Netzwerke aufbauen: Arbeite mit Führungsteams und CFOs zusammen und knüpfe Kontakte, die deine Karriere prägen werden.

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Entwickle deine Leadership-Skills in einem internationalen Team, das dich fördert und inspiriert. Besonders in der intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis Ostern leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden.

Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen.

Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest:

• Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung.

• Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit.

• Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen.

Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job
Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:
• Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten.

• Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen.

• Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren.

• Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Warum PwC? Weil wir wissen, was dir wichtig ist. Sinnvolle Arbeit, die einen Unterschied macht. Ein Team, das dich inspiriert. Und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.
