descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sei parte di un team che non solo controlla i numeri, ma riconosce le connessioni. In PwC, nel reparto Audit - Financial Services (Assicurazioni), analizzi le aziende: quanto sono efficaci? Dove si trovano le opportunità e i rischi? Come possono diventare più sostenibili? Qui lavori con persone curiose e ambiziose per plasmare l'economia del futuro - digitale, sostenibili e globali. Ogni progetto è unico e ti offre la possibilità di crescere e fare la differenza. La diversità è la nostra forza. La tua prospettiva conta e noi ti supportiamo per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi. Vuoi non solo un lavoro, ma fare qualcosa? Benvenuto in PwC! Qui puoi: - Comprendere e trasformare le aziende: controlla i bilanci consolidati e annuali e assicurati che soddisfino le esigenze normative - sul posto, in ufficio o in modo flessibile da casa. - Progettare il futuro digitalmente: utilizza strumenti all'avanguardia, intelligenza artificiale e analisi dei dati per portare l'audit a un nuovo livello. Le tue idee contano! - Promuovere la sostenibilità: supporta nella verifica dei rapporti ESG e accompagna le aziende nel loro percorso verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale. - Costruire reti: lavora con team di leadership e CFO e stabilisci contatti che daranno forma alla tua carriera. - Assumersi responsabilità: sviluppa le tue abilità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti promuove e ti ispira. Soprattutto nella intensa stagione di lavoro da gennaio a Pasqua, dai un contributo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti. ##
• Requisiti Se sei ancora incerto su come sia la vita quotidiana nella revisione contabile, prova la nostra Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 ore puoi risolvere questioni economico-aziendali reali e ottenere un'idea della pratica. Per noi contano la tua personalità, le tue abilità e la tua volontà di rendere il mondo un po' migliore. Oltre a questo, dovresti avere: - Un imminente o completato Bachelor o Master in Economia, Informatica (Economia), STEM o un altro indirizzo di studio. - Entusiasmo per i numeri, le tendenze digitali e la sostenibilità. - Il desiderio di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e collaborare con persone di culture diverse. - Comunicazione forte in tedesco e inglese. - Spirito di squadra e la capacità di risolvere le sfide con idee fresche. ##
• Cosa offriamo La tua prospettiva - più di un lavoro Sappiamo che l'inizio della vita lavorativa può essere emozionante, ma anche impegnativo. Ecco perché ti accompagniamo nel tuo percorso - con un piano chiaro e un forte supporto: - Promozione temporale e finanziaria: ti supportiamo completamente nella tua formazione come revisore contabile diplomato. Non solo ricevi un sostegno finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per organizzare al meglio il tuo tempo di apprendimento. - Flessibilità che si adatta a te: i nostri modelli di orario di lavoro ti danno la libertà di conciliare lavoro, apprendimento e tempo libero. - Mentorship e sviluppo: sarai accompagnato da colleghi esperti che ti promuovono e ti ispirano. - Un team che ti sostiene: da noi trovi una comunità che apprezza la diversità, celebra le idee e ti incoraggia a superare te stesso. ## Contatto
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description You are part of a team that not only checks numbers but recognizes connections. At PwC in the Audit - Financial Services (Insurance) department, you analyze companies: How successful are they? Where are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable? Here, you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow - digital, sustainable, and global. Every project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference. Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals. Do you want more than just a job, but something to achieve? Welcome to PwC! Here you can: - Understand and transform companies: Audit consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure they meet regulatory requirements - on site, in the office, or flexibly from home. - Digitally shape the future: Use state-of-the-art tools, AI, and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count! - Drive sustainability: Support the verification of ESG reports and accompany companies on their path to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility. - Build networks: Work with leadership teams and CFOs and make contacts that will shape your career. - Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that promotes and inspires you. Especially during the intense busy season from January to Easter, you make a decisive contribution to the success of our customers. ##
• Requirements If you're still unsure what everyday life in auditing looks like, try our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours, you can solve real business-related questions and get an insight into practice. For us, your personality, skills, and willingness to make the world a little better count. In addition to this, you should: - Have an upcoming or completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, (Business) Informatics, STEM, or another field of study. - Be enthusiastic about numbers, digital trends, and sustainability. - Desire to work in an international environment and collaborate with people from different cultures. - Strong communication in German and English. - Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas. ##
• What we offer Your perspective - more than just a job We know that starting your working life can be exciting but also challenging. That's why we accompany you on your journey - with a clear plan and strong support: - Time and financial support: We comprehensively support you in your training as a certified auditor. You not only receive financial support but also the flexibility to optimally design your learning time. - Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning, and leisure. - Mentoring and development: You will be accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you. - A team that strengthens you: Here, you find a community that appreciates diversity, celebrates ideas, and encourages you to grow beyond yourself. ## Contact Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together, we design the future of auditing - digital, sustainable, and global.

Description Vous faites partie d'une équipe qui ne se contente pas de vérifier les chiffres, mais qui reconnaît les liens. Chez PwC, dans le département Audit - Services financiers (assurance), vous analysez les entreprises : combien sont-elles efficaces ? Où se trouvent les opportunités et les risques ? Comment peuvent-elles devenir plus durables ? Ici, vous travaillez avec des personnes curieuses et ambitieuses pour façonner l'économie de demain - numérique, durable et mondiale. Chaque projet est unique et vous offre la chance de grandir et de faire une différence. La diversité est notre force. Votre perspective compte et nous vous soutenons pour atteindre vos objectifs. Voulez-vous plus qu'un simple emploi, mais quelque chose à accomplir ? Bienvenue chez PwC ! Ici, vous pouvez : - Comprendre et transformer les entreprises : auditez les états financiers consolidés et annuels et assurez-vous qu'ils répondent aux exigences réglementaires - sur place, au bureau ou de manière flexible depuis la maison. - Façonner l'avenir numérique : utilisez des outils à l'état de l'art, l'IA et l'analyse de données pour porter l'audit à un nouveau niveau. Vos idées comptent ! - Promouvoir la durabilité : soutenez la vérification des rapports ESG et accompagnez les entreprises sur leur chemin vers une plus grande conscience environnementale et une responsabilité sociale. - Construire des réseaux : travaillez avec des équipes de direction et des directeurs financiers et établissez des contacts qui façonneront votre carrière. - Assumer des responsabilités : développez vos compétences de leadership dans une équipe internationale qui vous promeut et vous inspire. Surtout pendant la saison intense de travail de janvier à Pâques, vous apportez une contribution décisive au succès de nos clients. ##
• Exigences Si vous êtes encore incertain sur la façon dont la vie quotidienne en audit se déroule, essayez notre Virtual Case Experience. En 3-4 heures, vous pouvez résoudre des questions réelles liées aux affaires et obtenir un aperçu de la pratique. Pour nous, votre personnalité, vos compétences et votre volonté de rendre le monde un peu meilleur comptent. En outre, vous devriez : - Avoir un diplôme de bachelor ou de master imminent ou complété en économie, informatique (économie), STEM ou un autre domaine d'étude. - Être enthousiaste pour les chiffres, les tendances numériques et la durabilité. - Désirer travailler dans un environnement international et collaborer avec des personnes de cultures différentes. - Communication solide en allemand et en anglais. - Esprit d'équipe et capacité à résoudre les défis avec des idées fraîches. ## Ce que nous offrons Votre perspective - plus qu'un emploi Nous savons que commencer votre vie active peut être excitant mais aussi difficile. C'est pourquoi nous vous accompagnons dans votre parcours - avec un plan clair et un soutien solide : - Soutien temporel et financier : nous vous soutenons de manière globale dans votre formation en tant qu'auditeur diplômé. Vous recevez non seulement un soutien financier, mais également la flexibilité pour concevoir de manière optimale votre temps d'apprentissage. - Flexibilité qui vous convient : nos modèles de temps de travail vous donnent la liberté de concilier travail, apprentissage et loisirs. - Mentorat et développement : vous serez accompagné par des collègues expérimentés qui vous promeuvent et vous inspirent. - Une équipe qui vous renforce : ici, vous trouverez une communauté qui apprécie la diversité, célèbre les idées et vous encourage à grandir au-delà de vous-même. ## Contact Postulez maintenant et devenez membre de notre Communauté de Solvers. Ensemble, nous concevons l'avenir de l'audit - numérique, durable et mondial.

jobs.description:
Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Bei PwC im Bereich Audit - Financial Services (Banken) analysierst du Unternehmen: Wie erfolgreich sind sie? Wo liegen Chancen und Risiken? Wie können sie nachhaltiger werden?

Hier arbeitest du mit neugierigen und ambitionierten Menschen, um die Wirtschaft von morgen zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen.

Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Deine Perspektive zählt, und wir unterstützen dich, deine Ziele zu erreichen.

Du willst nicht einfach nur einen Job, sondern etwas bewirken? Willkommen bei PwC! Hier kannst du:
• Unternehmen verstehen und transformieren: Prüfe Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse und stelle sicher, dass diese den regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen - vor Ort, im Office oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

• Digital die Zukunft gestalten: Nutze modernste Tools, KI und Datenanalyse, um die Wirtschaftsprüfung auf ein neues Level zu heben. Deine Ideen zählen!

• Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben: Unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ESG-Berichten und begleite Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Umweltbewusstsein und sozialer Verantwortung.

• Netzwerke aufbauen: Arbeite mit Führungsteams und CFOs zusammen und knüpfe Kontakte, die deine Karriere prägen werden.

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Entwickle deine Leadership-Skills in einem internationalen Team, das dich fördert und inspiriert. Besonders in der intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis Ostern leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden.

Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen.

Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest:

• Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung.

• Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit.

• Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen.

Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job
Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:
• Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten.

• Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen.

• Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren.

• Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Warum PwC? Weil wir wissen, was dir wichtig ist. Sinnvolle Arbeit, die einen Unterschied macht. Ein Team, das dich inspiriert. Und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei parte di una squadra che non solo controlla i numeri ma riconosce le relazioni. A PwC nell'area di Audit - Financial Services (Banks) si analizzano le aziende: Quanto hanno successo? Dove sono le opportunità e i rischi? Come possono diventare più sostenibili? Qui si lavora con persone curiosi e ambiziose per plasmare l'economia di domani – digitale, sostenibile e globale. Ogni progetto è unico e vi offre la possibilità di crescere e fare la differenza. La diversità è la nostra forza. La tua prospettiva conta e ti sosteniamo per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi. Non vuoi solo un lavoro, vuoi fare qualcosa? Benvenuti a PwC! Qui puoi:
• Comprendere e trasformare le aziende: controllare i conti consolidati e annuali e assicurarsi di soddisfare i requisiti normativi - in loco, in ufficio o in modo flessibile dall'ufficio.
• Formare digitalmente il futuro: utilizzare strumenti moderni, AI e analisi dei dati per aumentare l'audit a un nuovo livello. Conta le tue idee!
• Promuovere la sostenibilità: sostenere la valutazione dei rapporti ESG e sostenere le aziende sul loro percorso verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale.
• Costruire reti: lavorare con team di leadership e CFO e collegare i contatti che modellano la tua carriera.
• Responsabilità: sviluppare le tue capacità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti incoraggia e ti ispira. Soprattutto nell'intensa Stagione Bussa da gennaio a Pasqua si contribuisce in modo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti. Se non sei ancora sicuro di come la vita quotidiana guarda nell'audit, prova la nostra esperienza di caso virtuale. In 3-4 ore è possibile risolvere domande reali di affari e ottenere una visione della pratica. Con noi, la tua personalità, le tue capacità e la tua volontà di rendere il mondo un po' migliore. Cosa dovreste anche portare:
• Un diploma di laurea o di master in economia, informatica (economica), STEM o un altro campo di studio.
• Entusiasmo per figure, tendenze digitali e sostenibilità.
• Il desiderio di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e lavorare con persone di diverse culture.
• Forte comunicazione in tedesco e inglese.
• Spirito di squadra e la capacità di risolvere le sfide con idee fresche. La tua prospettiva - Più di un semplice lavoro Sappiamo che iniziare a lavorare può essere emozionante, ma anche impegnativo. Perciò vi accompagniamo sulla vostra strada - con un piano chiaro e un forte sostegno:
• Supporto periodico e finanziario: Vi sosteniamo in modo completo nella vostra formazione a/per dipl. Contabile:in. Non solo ricevi supporto finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per rendere il tuo tempo di apprendimento ottimale.
• Flessibilità che ti si addice: I nostri modelli di tempo di lavoro vi danno la libertà, la professione, l'apprendimento e il tempo libero per conciliare.
• Mentoraggio e sviluppo: siete accompagnati da colleghi esperti che vi promuovono e vi ispirano.
• Un team che vi rafforza: con noi troverete una comunità che apprezza la diversità, celebra le idee e vi incoraggia a crescere oltre di voi. Perché PwC? Perche' sappiamo cosa e' importante per te. Lavoro sensibile che fa la differenza. Una squadra che ti ispira. E l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente il futuro. Entrate ora e diventate parte della nostra Comunità di Solvers. Insieme formiamo il futuro dell'auditing - digitale, sostenibile e globale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You are part of a team that not only checks numbers but recognizes relationships. At PwC in the area of Audit - Financial Services (Banks) you analyze companies: How successful are they? Where are opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable? Here you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow – digital, sustainable and global. Each project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference. Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts and we support you to achieve your goals. You don't just want a job, you want to do something? Welcome to PwC! Here you can:
• Understanding and transforming companies: Check consolidated and annual accounts and make sure they meet the regulatory requirements - on site, in the office or flexibly from the home office.
• Digitally shape the future: Use modern tools, AI and data analysis to raise the audit to a new level. Count your ideas!
• Promote sustainability: support the assessment of ESG reports and support companies on their path to more environmental awareness and social responsibility.
• Build networks: work with leadership teams and CFOs and connect contacts that will shape your career.
• Responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that encourages and inspires you. Especially in the intense Busy Season from January to Easter you make a decisive contribution to the success of our customers. If you are still unsure how everyday life looks in the audit, try out our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours you can solve real business questions and gain an insight into the practice. With us, your personality, your skills and your will to make the world a bit better. What you should also bring:
• An upcoming or completed bachelor's or master's degree in economics, (economic) informatics, STEM or another field of study.
• Enthusiasm for figures, digital trends and sustainability.
• The desire to work in an international environment and work with people from different cultures.
• Strong communication in German and English.
• Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas. Your perspective - More than just a job We know that starting to work can be exciting, but also challenging. Therefore we accompany you on your way - with a clear plan and strong support:
• Periodic and financial support: We support you comprehensively in your training at/to dipl. Accountant:in. You not only receive financial support, but also the flexibility to make your learning time optimal.
• Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom, profession, learning and leisure to reconcile.
• Mentoring and development: You are accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you.
• A team that strengthens you: with us you will find a community that appreciates diversity, celebrates ideas and encourages you to grow beyond you. Why PwC? Because we know what's important to you. Sensual work that makes a difference. A team that inspires you. And the opportunity to actively shape the future. Join now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together we shape the future of auditing - digital, sustainable and global.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous faites partie d'une équipe qui non seulement vérifie les chiffres, mais reconnaît les relations. Chez PwC dans le domaine de l'audit - Services financiers (banques), vous analysez les entreprises : Quelle est leur réussite? Où sont les possibilités et les risques? Comment peuvent-ils devenir plus durables? Ici, vous travaillez avec des gens curieux et ambitieux pour façonner l'économie de demain – numérique, durable et globale. Chaque projet est unique et vous offre la possibilité de grandir et de faire une différence. La diversité est notre force. Votre perspective compte et nous vous soutenons pour atteindre vos objectifs. Tu ne veux pas juste un boulot, tu veux faire quelque chose ? Bienvenue à PwC ! Ici vous pouvez:
• comprendre et transformer les entreprises: vérifier les comptes consolidés et annuels et s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux exigences réglementaires - sur place, dans le bureau ou avec souplesse à partir du bureau d'attache.
• Façonner l'avenir numériquement : utiliser des outils modernes, l'IA et l'analyse des données pour élever l'audit à un niveau nouveau. Vos idées comptent !
• Promouvoir la durabilité: soutien à l'évaluation des rapports ESG et soutien aux entreprises sur la voie d'une plus grande sensibilisation à l'environnement et à la responsabilité sociale.
• Créer des réseaux : travailler avec les équipes de leadership et les OFC et relier les contacts qui façonneront votre carrière.
• Responsabilité : développez vos compétences en leadership dans une équipe internationale qui vous encourage et vous inspire. En particulier dans l'intense saison de travail de janvier à Pâques, vous apportez une contribution décisive au succès de nos clients. Si vous n'êtes toujours pas sûr de l'apparence de la vie quotidienne dans l'audit, essayez notre expérience de cas virtuel. En 3-4 heures vous pouvez résoudre de vraies questions d'affaires et obtenir un aperçu de la pratique. Avec nous, votre personnalité, vos compétences et votre volonté de rendre le monde un peu meilleur. Ce que vous devriez aussi apporter:
• Un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en économie, (économique) informatique, STEM ou un autre domaine d'études.
• L'enthousiasme pour les chiffres, les tendances numériques et la durabilité.
• La volonté de travailler dans un environnement international et de travailler avec des gens de différentes cultures.
• Une communication forte en allemand et en anglais.
• L'esprit d'équipe et la capacité de résoudre les défis avec de nouvelles idées. Votre perspective - Plus qu'un simple travail Nous savons que le début du travail peut être excitant, mais aussi stimulant. C'est pourquoi nous vous accompagnons sur votre chemin - avec un plan clair et un soutien fort:
• soutien temporaire et financier: Nous vous accompagnons de manière complète dans votre formation chez/à dipl. Comptable:in. Vous bénéficiez non seulement d'un soutien financier, mais aussi de la flexibilité nécessaire pour optimiser votre temps d'apprentissage.
• Flexibilité qui vous convient : Nos modèles de temps de travail vous donnent la liberté, la profession, l'apprentissage et les loisirs à concilier.
• Mentoring et développement : vous serez accompagné de collègues expérimentés qui vous encouragent et vous inspirent.
• Une équipe qui vous renforce : avec nous vous trouverez une communauté qui apprécie la diversité, célèbre les idées et vous encourage à grandir au-delà de vous. Pourquoi PwC ? Parce que nous savons ce qui est important pour vous. Un travail sensuel qui fait une différence. Une équipe qui vous inspire. Et l'occasion de façonner activement l'avenir. Rejoignez maintenant et faites partie de notre Communauté des Solvers. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir de l'audit - numérique, durable et mondial.

jobs.title: Director - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - Generative AI
jobs.description:
• You manage engagements with clients and PwC teams, serving as a key leader within our organization.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate the complexities of AI adoption

• Lead workshops and discussions with clients or internal stakeholders to identify AI use cases, understand business challenges, and align AI tailored solutions.

• Facilitate your clients' advancement in digitization by gathering their requirements and proposing state-of-the-art solutions.

• Anticipate and address potential risks associated with AI implementation, such as data privacy, security, and model performance.

• Implement and continuously expand your knowledge of best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approach.

• A university master's degree or PhD in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any natural sciences or engineering discipline is preferred.

• Over 10 years of work experience evidencing experience with artificial intelligence technologies (such as machine learning, deep learning, advanced statistics and modelling) and more recently in Generative AI (including Agentic AI, GenAI-related cloud technologies, ML engineering).

• As experienced hire, you have a solid track record in delivering and overachieving on your projects and you can rely on your network within AI space.

• Proven experience in AI leadership roles, with a track record of delivering impactful AI solutions. Consulting experienced is considered a plus.

• Proven go-to-market experience within the Swiss market is mandatory, with a strong understanding of local business dynamics and needs.

• Fluency in English with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally internationally; German or French language skills are considered a plus.

titleByLocale.it: Direttore - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - Generative AI
titleByLocale.en: Director - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - Generative AI

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - IA générique

descriptionByLocale.it: Gestisci engagement con i clienti e i team PwC, svolgendo un ruolo di leadership chiave all'interno della nostra organizzazione. Agisci come consulente di fiducia per i clienti, aiutandoli a navigare nelle complessità dell'adozione dell'AI. Guida workshop e discussioni con i clienti o gli stakeholder interni per identificare casi d'uso AI, comprendere le sfide aziendali e allineare soluzioni AI personalizzate. Facilita l'avanzamento dei tuoi clienti nella digitalizzazione raccogliendo i loro requisiti e proponendo soluzioni all'avanguardia. Anticipa e affronta i potenziali rischi associati all'implementazione dell'AI, come la privacy dei dati, la sicurezza e le performance del modello. Implementa e amplia continuamente le tue conoscenze sulle best practice in tecnologia, data engineering, analytics e approccio consulenziale. Si preferisce una laurea magistrale o un dottorato in campi come intelligenza artificiale, informatica, fisica, matematica o qualsiasi disciplina di scienze naturali o ingegneria. Oltre 10 anni di esperienza lavorativa che dimostri esperienza con tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale (come machine learning, deep learning, statistica avanzata e modellazione) e più recentemente in AI Generativa (inclusa AI Agentiva, tecnologie cloud correlate alla GenAI, ML engineering). In qualità di profilo esperto, hai un solido track record nella delivery e nel superamento degli obiettivi dei tuoi progetti e puoi fare affidamento sulla tua rete nel settore AI. Comprovata esperienza in ruoli di leadership AI, con un track record di delivery di soluzioni AI di impatto. L'esperienza in consulenza è considerata un plus. Comprovata esperienza go-to-market nel mercato svizzero è obbligatoria, con una forte comprensione delle dinamiche e delle esigenze aziendali locali. Fluente in inglese con disponibilità a viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente a livello internazionale; le competenze in tedesco o francese sono considerate un plus.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sie leiten Engagements mit Kunden und PwC-Teams und fungieren als Schlüsselfigur innerhalb unserer Organisation. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater unterstützen Sie Kunden dabei, die Komplexität der KI-Einführung zu bewältigen. Leiten Sie Workshops und Diskussionen mit Kunden oder internen Stakeholdern, um KI-Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren, geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu verstehen und massgeschneiderte KI-Lösungen abzustimmen. Fördern Sie den Fortschritt Ihrer Kunden bei der Digitalisierung, indem Sie ihre
• Anforderungen aufnehmen und modernste Lösungen vorschlagen. Erkennen und adressieren Sie potenzielle Risiken im Zusammenhang mit der KI-Implementierung, wie Datenschutz, Sicherheit und Modellleistung. Implementieren und erweitern Sie kontinuierlich Ihr Wissen über Best Practices in Technologie, Datentechnik, Analytik und Beratungsansätzen. Ein universitärer Master-Abschluss oder Doktortitel in Bereichen wie künstliche Intelligenz, Informatik, Physik, Mathematik oder einer Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaft wird bevorzugt. Über 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit nachweisbarer Erfahrung in Technologien der künstlichen Intelligenz (wie maschinelles Lernen, Deep Learning, fortgeschrittene Statistik und Modellierung) und neuerdings in Generative AI (einschliesslich Agentic AI, GenAI-bezogene Cloud-Technologien, ML-Engineering). Als erfahrene Fachkraft verfügen Sie über eine solide Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung und Übererfüllung Ihrer Projekte und können sich auf Ihr Netzwerk im KI-Bereich stützen. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in KI-Führungsrollen mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung wirkungsvoller KI-Lösungen. Beratungserfahrung gilt als Plus. Nachgewiesene Go-to-Market-Erfahrung im Schweizer Markt ist zwingend erforderlich, mit einem fundierten Verständnis der lokalen Geschäftsdynamiken und -bedürfnisse. Fliessende Englischkenntnisse und Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich international; Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Vous gérez les missions avec les clients et les équipes PwC, en jouant un rôle clé au sein de notre organisation. Agissez en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des clients, en les aidant à naviguer dans les complexités de l'adoption de l'IA. Animez des ateliers et des discussions avec les clients ou les parties prenantes internes pour identifier les cas d'usage de l'IA, comprendre les enjeux métier et aligner les solutions IA sur mesure. Facilitez l'avancement de vos clients dans la digitalisation en recueillant leurs exigences et en proposant des solutions à la pointe de la technologie. Anticipez et adressez les risques potentiels associés à la mise en œuvre de l'IA, tels que la confidentialité des données, la sécurité et la performance des modèles. Mettez en œuvre et développez continuellement vos connaissances des meilleures pratiques en matière de technologie, d'ingénierie des données, d'analytique et d'approche conseil. Un master universitaire ou un doctorat dans des domaines tels que l'intelligence artificielle, l'informatique, la physique, les mathématiques ou toute discipline scientifique ou d'ingénierie est préféré. Plus de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle démontrant une expérience avec les technologies d'intelligence artificielle (telles que le machine learning, le deep learning, les statistiques avancées et la modélisation) et plus récemment dans l'IA générative (incluant l'IA agentique, les technologies cloud liées à GenAI, l'ingénierie ML). jobs.title: Senior Associate - Supply Chain Cyber Security Specialist (Cyber Risk Advisory)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Associate in our Cybersecurity and Privacy team, you will play a key role in delivering and growing our supply chain cyber risk capability across all sectors of clients. You will help our clients strengthen their third-party cyber risk management programs, comply with evolving regulatory expectations such as DORA, NIS2, and respond to emerging threats across complex, global supply chains.

This is a growth-focused role, supporting engagements across multiple financial services and non-financial services clients, many of which are part of multi-year transformation programs.

As part of the Cybersecurity and Privacy team of PwC Switzerland, you will work on:
• delivering client engagements focused on supply chain cyber security, third party risk, and compliance with DORA, NIS2, and related regulations across industries;

• designing and implementing supplier segmentation, cyber risk assessments, control testing, continuous monitoring, and incident response processes as part of broader Supplier Risk and IT GRC transformations;

• collaborating with clients to define and operationalize future state Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) operating models, including roles and responsibilities, escalation paths, and response plans;

• building AI augmented TPRM capabilities and workflows leveraging platforms such as ServiceNow, ProcessUnity, BitSight, RiskRecon, and SecurityScorecard, including tooling configuration and integrations;

• developing pragmatic recommendations and roadmaps to improve cyber risk governance, continuous monitoring, and incident/issue management across the third party lifecycle;

• leading and contributing to workshops, reporting, and executive ready presentations for CISO, CIO, Risk, Compliance, and Procurement stakeholders;

• supporting internal capability building, contributing to thought leadership, market propositions, proposal responses, and account expansion initiatives; and

• coaching and mentoring junior team members while fostering a high performance, inclusive team culture.

We are looking for a Senior Associate who embodies our core values and brings a strong background in cyber security:

• You have at minimum 5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, third-party risk, or supply chain risk management.

• You have a master's or bachelor's degree or an equivalent professional qualification in business administration or computer science. Additional certificates such as CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISSP are a plus.

• Proven experience working with financial services clients, ideally within regulatory-driven engagements (e.g., DORA, NIS2).

• Strong understanding of supply chain cybersecurity frameworks, supplier risk segmentation, control testing, and cyber risk quantification.

• Familiarity with supply chain risk platforms such as ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, BitSight, RiskRecon, or equivalent.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing skills.

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.

• You are fluent in English and (ideally) also in German and/or French.

• You have a high degree of initiative, self-organisation and sense of responsibility.

Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• As a member of our Cybersecurity consulting team, specializing in Data Protection, you will bring deep technical expertise to help clients secure and protect their most valuable data.

• You will lead and deliver hands-on implementation and configuration of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions - from initial setup through optimization - ensuring clients get maximum value from their investments.

• You will work with cutting edge data security projects and assist in defining requirements, use cases, strategy, including areas such as AI, Quantum and architecture for Data Protection solutions.

• Proven experience in end-to-end data protection projects: scoping, setup, policy design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation tuning.

• 3+ years of hands-on technical experience implementing, configuring, and operating DLP solutions (Microsoft Purview DLP, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or equivalent technologies).

• Strong technical understanding of data protection concepts, data classification, sensitive data handling, and endpoint/network/cloud DLP controls.

• Experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery role is considered advantageous.

• Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus.

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or another equivalent technical education; professional certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Microsoft Security certifications) are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Audit Trade, Industries & Services
jobs.description:
In deiner Rolle als erfahrener Profi im Bereich Audit – Trade, Industries & Services bei PwC bist du Teil eines Teams, bei dem deine Erfahrung und Perspektive zählt. Wir legen großen Wert auf Vielfalt und unterstützen dich dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen zu meistern.

Du gestaltest die Wirtschaft von morgen mit – digital, nachhaltig und global.

• Du prüfst Jahres- und Konzernrechnungen bei nationalen und internationalen Konzernen und Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Industrie, Handel und dem Dienstleistungssektor.

• Geschäftsprozesse werden von dir geprüft und du leistest Hilfestellung bei Fragen zur Rechnungslegung nach verschiedenen Standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).

• Mit dem/der Engagement Manager:in arbeitest du an der Planung, Durchführung und Finalisierung verschiedener Prüfaufträge sowie verschiedener Sonderprüfungen und bist dabei im direkten Austausch mit weiteren Fachspezialist:innen.

• Du bist Teil der digitalen Revolution der Wirtschaftsprüfung, indem du unsere digitalen Prüftools und -ansätze einsetzt und mithilfst, sie zu verbessern.

• Der Erwerb von vertieften Kenntnissen eines breiten Kundenspektrums und das Aufbauen sowie Pflegen von Kundenbeziehungen sprechen dich an.

• Du wirst von uns in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung durch On- und Off-the-Job-Coaching unterstützt, um deine langfristigen Karriereziele zu erreichen.

• Als Teil eines inspirierenden, diversifizierten Team befindest du dich in einem internationalen Netzwerk und erhältst regelmässig Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten.

• Du absolvierst die Ausbildung zum/zur Dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder hast diese soeben abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung mit und hast dabei Einblicke in betriebswirtschaftliche Prüfungen von Unternehmen gewonnen.

• Du hast ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an dich und das Team und möchtest aktiv die Digitalisierung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung vorantreiben.

• Du bist motiviert und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Ansprüche unserer Kund:innen zu übertreffen.

• Du bist bereit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich in einem Umfeld mit einer aktiven Coachingkultur zu bewegen.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

You will help shape the economy of tomorrow – digital, sustainable and global.

• You have strong analytical skills, high quality standards for yourself and the team and would like to actively promote digitalization in auditing.
• You are motivated and help design solutions to exceed the demands of our customers.
• You are ready to take on responsibility right from the start and work in an environment with an active coaching culture.
• You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.

jobs.title: Associate / Senior Associate - Cloud, Data & AI (Data Engineering)
jobs.description:
• Collaborate with your team to deliver high-impact projects and engage with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients in industries such as Pharma & Life Sciences, Financial Services, Retail & Consumer, Industrial Manufacturing, and Public Services.

• Empower your clients to innovatively leverage their data by proposing and developing the most suitable data-driven solutions according to the clients' needs and the availability/properties of their data.

• Assist your clients in advancing digitization with data pipelines and analyzes of various data sources. The projects you are working on include the technical and analytical development of end-to-end data engineering, analytics, and automation solutions.

• Challenge the status quo, seek the information you need, understand the challenge at hand, and devise creative and simple solutions.

• Implement and continue learning best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approaches

• A university degree in fields such as business informatics, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any engineering discipline is preferred.

• Initial work experience in data engineering, data science, visualization, or analytics (including thesis work) adds value.

• Proficiency in multiple programming languages like Python, R, SQL, or similar is required.

• Hands-on experience with Azure, GCP, AWS, or DataBricks is essential.

• Excellent interpersonal, listening, and communication skills, coupled with a proactive attitude towards delivering client value, are vital.

• Fluency in English and German and a willingness to travel within Switzerland, and occasionally internationally, are necessary.

I progetti su cui stai lavorando includono lo sviluppo tecnico e analitico delle soluzioni di ingegneria, analisi e automazione dei dati end-to-end. - Sfidare lo status quo, cercare le informazioni necessarie, capire la sfida a portata di mano, e ideare soluzioni creative e semplici. - Implementare e continuare a imparare le migliori pratiche in tecnologia, ingegneria dei dati, analisi e approcci di consulenza ##

jobs.title: Life Transformation Aktuar/-in – Manager/in
jobs.description:
• Du berätst führende Lebens-(Rück-) Versicherungsgesellschaften in der Schweiz im Rahmen strategischer Transformationsprojekte, z. B. Systemmigrationen, Prozessoptimierungen oder Modernisierungen von aktuariellen Funktionen.

• Du bringst aktuarielles Fachwissen in multidisziplinäre Teams ein und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen aktuariellen, IT- und Business-Funktionen.

• Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende aktuariellen Modelle, Tarifierungs- oder Reservierungsprozesse.

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einzelne Projektstreams oder leitest kleinere Projektteams.

• Du unterstützt beim Auf- und Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsangebots im Bereich Life Insurance bei.

• Du verfügst über einen Universitätsabschluss in Mathematik, Statistik, Actuarial Science oder Naturwissenschaften.

• Du hast 5–8 Jahre relevante aktuarielle Berufserfahrung im Lebensversicherungsmarkt, sei es in einer (Rück-)versicherungsgesellschaft oder in der Beratung in der Schweiz.

• Du bist Aktuar SAV oder verfügst über eine äquivalente ausländische Qualifikation.

• Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Tarifierung, Reservierung oder Reporting (OR, IFRS 17) von Lebensversicherungsprodukten.

• Du hast bereits erste Führungs- und Projekterfahrung, idealerweise in grösseren Transformationsprojekten.

• Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Zertifizierungen in Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Azure, AWS) oder Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung bzw. -orchestrierung (z. B. Camunda) sind von Vorteil.

jobs.title: Audit – Career Start im Bereich Financial Services - Herbst 2026
jobs.description:
Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Bei PwC im Bereich Audit - Financial Services (Banken, Asset Manager, Versicherungen) analysierst du Unternehmen: Wie erfolgreich sind sie? Wo liegen Chancen und Risiken? Wie können sie nachhaltiger werden?

Hier arbeitest du mit neugierigen und ambitionierten Menschen, um die Wirtschaft von morgen zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen.

Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Deine Perspektive zählt, und wir unterstützen dich, deine Ziele zu erreichen.

Du willst nicht einfach nur einen Job, sondern etwas bewirken? Willkommen bei PwC! Hier kannst du:
• Unternehmen verstehen und transformieren: Prüfe Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse und stelle sicher, dass diese den regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen - vor Ort, im Office oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

• Digital die Zukunft gestalten: Nutze modernste Tools, KI und Datenanalyse, um die Wirtschaftsprüfung auf ein neues Level zu heben. Deine Ideen zählen!

• Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben: Unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ESG-Berichten und begleite Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Umweltbewusstsein und sozialer Verantwortung.

• Netzwerke aufbauen: Arbeite mit Führungsteams und CFOs zusammen und knüpfe Kontakte, die deine Karriere prägen werden.

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Entwickle deine Leadership-Skills in einem internationalen Team, das dich fördert und inspiriert. Besonders in der intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis Ostern leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden.

Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen.

Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest:

• Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung.

• Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit.

• Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen.

Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job
Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:
• Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Manager - SAP Master Data Governance Consulting
jobs.description:
As one of the leading global professional services firms, PwC offers a wide range of consulting services across various industries, helping organisations navigate complex challenges and achieve their strategic goals. We work closely with clients to provide tailored solutions that address their specific needs, whether it's developing innovative strategies, improving operational efficiency, or leveraging emerging technologies.

• Lead and support large-scale projects focusing on S/4HANA or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) within Switzerland and internationally.

• Collaborate with clients to assess and enhance their master data governance processes, leveraging SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

• Guide clients from the conceptualization of initial ideas through to successful operational implementation, ensuring seamless integration of SAP MDG solutions.

• Design and enhance SAP standard software solutions, tailoring them to meet specific client needs and industry standards.

• Develop custom applications and integrate various software solutions to optimize client operations and data management strategies.

• Bachelor's or master's degree in business, IT, engineering, business information systems, or a related field.

• 3 to 6 years of experience in process consulting and implementation of SAP solutions, with a focus on SAP Master Data Governance and a deep understanding of associated business processes.

• Proven expertise in implementing SAP MDG for Customer, Vendor, Material, or Financial domains, translating business process requirements into technical solutions.

• Experience in process modeling, including entity and business activity changes, workflow design, data replication techniques, and master data conversion.

• Strong analytical skills with practical experience in process analysis and design across various industries.

• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are advantageous.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Cyber Technology and Transformation
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• Be part of our diverse Cybersecurity team and play a pivotal role in delivering security engagements spanning Exposure Management, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, and many more.

• Serve as key contact for our clients, taking on the end-to-end management and successful delivery of our engagements.

• Provide strategic guidance to clients to support them on their cyber journey.

• Drive the evaluation and implementation of cyber technologies to improve the cybersecurity maturity of our clients.

• Build and drive your own cyber capability, from business development to contributing to the development of innovative services within our cyber technology and transformation practice.

• Shape and mentor cross-functional teams to develop and execute long term client relationships and to accelerate a collaborative work environment.

• Min. 5 years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity and prior consulting experience from either a consultancy firm or an internal corporate consulting function or role.

• Master's or bachelor's degree or an equivalent professional qualification. Additional certificates such as CISSP, CISM, SSCP are a plus.

• Knowledge and hands on experience in managing security projects in key domains such as security operations, security architecture, Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud security etc.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.

• Fluent in English; German or French are a plus.

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager - Senior Cyber Security Architect
jobs.description:
Are you eager to make a mark in the market as a knowledgeable and influential figure in cyber security architecture and solutions in the areas such as Cloud, OT, Zero Trust, Data & Network? Look no further because you have found your place. Join our team and support our Cybersecurity unit in evolving our cyber transformation practice.
As part of our global network, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with diverse and compelling teams, where your proactive and forward-thinking mindset will be highly valued and encouraged.

• Join our diverse Cybersecurity team and collaborate within our global community of experts to guide the design and implementation of comprehensive cybersecurity architectures for clients.

• You will be responsible for designing and delivering robust, scalable, and future-proof security architectures for our diverse client base

• Act as the lead security architect on projects, providing expert guidance and industry good practices. Example areas would be Zero Trust, Network, OT, Data & Cloud, Cryptography.

• Assess client cybersecurity posture and provide strategic recommendations aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements

• You will be a key role in large scale business and cyber transformation programs. You will also collaborate closely with client IT, risk, and compliance teams to integrate security solutions into business processes

• Conduct security risk assessments and threat modeling to guide architecture decisions.

• Participate in proposals, client presentations, and workshops to communicate complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Cultivate a client network, establishing yourself as the go-to person on security needs within PwC.

• Coach and develop your team members on their career path, while contributing to the overall team growth strategy.

• At least 8+ years of experience in Information Security architecture with at least 4 years dedicated to security architecture. Additionally, well conversent in Cloud, Network, Zero Trust, Data Protection, or any related domains.

• Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in IT, Business IT or a related field. Information Security certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, CISM, TOGAF, or CCSP are highly desirable

• Experience with DevSecOps practices , and implementation of security tools is a strong plus.

• Good mentorship and team-building skills.

• Ability to communicate complex security concepts in busines context to a broad range of audiences.

• Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage executive-level stakeholders.

• Analytical mindset and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Fluent in English; German or French are a plus.

jobs.title: Manager Capital Markets
jobs.description:
• You are part of the high performing Capital Markets and Accounting Advisory Solutions (CMAAS) team executing and delivering on transactions projects including IPOs, debt & equity offerings and cross border transactions (e.g.144As).

• You advise our clients on acquisitions and disposals including complex financial history, pro-forma, carve out reporting in multiple capital markets (e.g. SIX and SEC regulations).

• You advise on accounting standard changes and GAAP conversion projects.

• You develop new and extend existing relationships with our clients and actively support the client targeting and acquisition process.

• You are in the driver seat of your own responsibility, flexibility and development.

• You develop your leadership skills and share your expertise and experience actively by teaching, coaching and mentoring others.

• You are a Certified Public Accountant (Switzerland and/or other country).

• You have strong knowledge of accounting standards (IFRS, US GAAP and/or Swiss GAAP FER), industry credentials and transaction experience, if possible.

• You have 4-5 years experience as audit senior / manager or similar positions. You have a track record of project management, client management and high risk & services orientation.

• You have excellent English, German or French (both written and verbal) skills. You have strong communication skills, are very client-oriented, flexible and willing to travel and work in an international network.

• You drive your career together with your coach by setting clear career objectives and making conscious career choices.

• You bring in your external network and leverage your personal relationships.

descriptionByLocale.it:
**Titolo della posizione:** Senior Manager, Capital Markets and Accounting Advisory Solutions **Descrizione del ruolo:** Fai parte del team ad alte prestazioni Capital Markets and Accounting Advisory Solutions (CMAAS), eseguendo e portando a termine progetti di transazione, tra cui IPO, offerte di debito e capitale, e transazioni transfrontaliere (es. 144A). Consiglierai i nostri clienti su acquisizioni e cessioni, incluse storie finanziarie complesse, rendiconti pro-forma, carve-out in più mercati dei capitali (es. regolamentazioni SIX e SEC). **Responsabilità principali:** - Consigliare i clienti sui cambiamenti degli standard contabili e sui progetti di conversione GAAP - Sviluppare nuove relazioni con i clienti e ampliare quelle esistenti, supportando attivamente il processo di acquisizione clienti - Assumere la responsabilità dei propri compiti, con flessibilità e crescita professionale - Sviluppare competenze di leadership e condividere esperienza e know-how attraverso l'insegnamento, il coaching e il mentoring **
• Requisiti:** - Revisore dei conti certificato (Svizzera e/o altri Paesi) - Solida conoscenza degli standard contabili (IFRS, US GAAP e/o Swiss GAAP FER), credenziali di settore ed esperienza nelle transazioni (preferibile) - 4-5 anni di esperienza come senior/manager di revisione o posizioni analoghe - Comprovata esperienza in gestione di progetti, gestione clienti e orientamento ai servizi ad alto rischio - Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese, del tedesco o del francese (sia scritto che parlato) - Forti capacità comunicative, orientamento al cliente, flessibilità e disponibilità a viaggiare e lavorare in una rete internazionale - Capacità di guidare la propria carriera insieme al proprio coach, definendo obiettivi chiari e compiendo scelte consapevoli - Capacità di valorizzare la propria rete esterna e le relazioni personali

Sie entwickeln Ihre Führungsfähigkeiten und teilen Ihr Know-how und Ihre Erfahrung aktiv durch Lehren, Coaching und Mentoring anderen. Sie sind ein Certified Public Accountant (Schweiz und/oder anderes Land). Sie haben starke Kenntnisse über Rechnungslegungsstandards (IFRS, US GAAP und/oder Swiss GAAP FER), Branchen-Anmelde- und Transaktionserfahrung, wenn möglich. Sie haben 4-5 Jahre Erfahrung als Audit Senior / Manager oder ähnliche Positionen. Sie haben einen Überblick über Projektmanagement, Kundenmanagement und eine hohe Risiko- und Dienstleistungsorientierung. Sie haben hervorragende Englisch, Deutsch oder Französisch (beide schriftliche und verbale) Fähigkeiten. Sie haben starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sind sehr kundenorientiert, flexibel und bereit, in einem internationalen Netzwerk zu reisen und zu arbeiten. Sie fahren Ihre Karriere zusammen mit Ihrem Trainer, indem Sie klare Karriereziele und bewusste Karrierewahlen. Sie bringen Ihr externes Netzwerk ein und nutzen Ihre persönlichen Beziehungen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Vous faites partie de l'équipe hautement performante de Capital Markets and Accounting Advisory Solutions (CMAAS) qui exécute et exécute des projets de transactions, y compris des OPI, des offres de dettes et d'actions et des transactions transfrontalières (p. ex. 144A). Vous conseillez nos clients sur les acquisitions et les cessions, y compris l'historique financier complexe, le pro-forma, l'établissement de rapports sur plusieurs marchés de capitaux (p. ex. les règlements SIX et SEC). Vous conseillez sur les changements de normes comptables et les projets de conversion des PCGR. Vous développez de nouvelles relations et élargissez les relations existantes avec nos clients et soutenez activement le processus de ciblage et d'acquisition des clients. Vous êtes au volant de votre propre responsabilité, flexibilité et développement. Vous développez vos compétences en leadership et partagez activement votre expertise et votre expérience en enseignant, en coachant et en mentorant les autres. Vous êtes un comptable public certifié (Suisse et/ou autre pays). Vous avez une bonne connaissance des normes comptables (IFRS, US GAAP et/ou Swiss GAAP FER), des qualifications de l'industrie et de l'expérience transactionnelle, si possible. Vous avez de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que cadre supérieur / gestionnaire de vérification ou postes similaires. Vous avez une expérience de gestion de projet, de gestion de client et d'orientation à haut risque et services. Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en anglais, en allemand ou en français (écrit et verbal). Vous avez de solides compétences en communication, êtes très orienté client, flexible et disposé à voyager et à travailler dans un réseau international. Vous conduisez votre carrière avec votre entraîneur en fixant des objectifs de carrière clairs et en faisant des choix de carrière conscients. Vous apportez votre réseau externe et exploitez vos relations personnelles.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
• Collaborate with your team to source high-impact projects and engage with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients in diverse industries such as Pharma & Life Sciences, Financial Services, Retail & Consumer, Industrial Products, and Public Services.

• Empower your clients to innovatively leverage their data by proposing holistic end-to-end solutions, ensuring successful delivery and value generation in alignment with their specific needs.

• Facilitate your clients' advancement in digitization by gathering their requirements and proposing state-of-the-art solutions.

• Challenge the status quo, actively seek necessary information, comprehend the challenges, and communicate your ideas clearly to senior stakeholders.

• Implement and continuously expand your knowledge of best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approach.

• A university degree in fields such as business informatics, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any engineering discipline is preferred.

• Over 7 years of work experience focused on data engineering, analytics, or data science, with consulting experience considered a bonus.

• Experience in sourcing, preparing, and delivering end-to-end solutions to internal or external clients is crucial.

• Proficiency in multiple programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or similar is required.

• Experience in developing and deploying data engineering or AI applications is advantageous.

• Fluency in English and German, with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally internationally; French language skills are considered a plus.

Consenti ai tuoi clienti di sfruttare in modo innovativo i propri dati proponendo soluzioni olistiche end-to-end, garantendo una consegna efficace e la generazione di valore in linea con le loro esigenze specifiche. descriptionByLocale.fr: Collaborez avec votre équipe pour identifier des projets à fort impact et interagir avec des parties prenantes senior de clients prestigieux dans des secteurs variés tels que Pharma & Life Sciences, Services Financiers, Retail & Consumer, Produits Industriels et Services Publics. Donnez à vos clients les moyens d'exploiter leurs données de manière innovante en proposant des solutions holistiques de bout en bout, en garantissant une livraison réussie et une création de valeur adaptée à leurs besoins spécifiques. Facilitez la progression numérique de vos clients en recueillant leurs besoins et en proposant des solutions de pointe. Remettez en question le statu quo, recherchez activement les informations nécessaires, comprenez les défis et communiquez clairement vos idées aux parties prenantes senior. Mettez en œuvre et développez continuellement vos connaissances des meilleures pratiques en matière de technologie, data engineering, analytics et approche conseil. Un diplôme universitaire dans des domaines tels que l'informatique de gestion, l'informatique, la physique, les mathématiques ou toute discipline d'ingénierie est préféré. Plus de 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle axée sur le data engineering, l'analytics ou la data science, l'expérience en conseil étant un atout. Une expérience dans la conception, la préparation et la livraison de solutions end-to-end à des clients internes ou externes est indispensable. La maîtrise de plusieurs langages de programmation tels que Python, R, SQL ou similaires est requise. Une expérience dans le développement et le déploiement d'applications de data engineering ou d'IA est un avantage. Maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand, avec une volonté de voyager en Suisse et occasionnellement à l'international ; la connaissance du français est considérée comme un atout.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Cyber Cloud Security
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of a team which pushes cloud adoption forward? Are you ready to push the market with your own service portfolio on cloud security solutions? Then you are looking at the right job! Support the PwC Cybersecurity practice by shaping and developing our cyber cloud vision, being an active part of our Cybersecurity leadership team, and helping our clients to realise the benefits of cloud in a secure way.

Your Skill Set
• A decade of experience, ideally with a focus on consulting assignments, securing cloud deployments to at least one of Azure, GCP or AWS, and the ability to articulate the differences in security offerrings between all three.

• Hands on experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) capabilities and the ability to articulate when and why solutions like Wiz, Palo Alto and others can be relevant to help secure a cloud deployment.

• A bachelor's and master's degree in IT, Communications, or Cyber Security. Information Security certifications such as CISSP, CISA or CISM. Ideally also experience with highly regulated environments, ISO270001 and ISO42001 (AI) are preferred.

• Demonstrate a proven track record in implementing secure cloud deployments from initial assessment to designing and implementing core cloud security capabilities, including highly automated and optimised processes.

• Exhibit strong presentation, project management and delivery skills, coupled with strong problem-solving skills. A blend of consulting and industry / in-house experience would be highly desirable.

• Relevant project methodology certificates (e.g., SCRUM, SAFe, PRINCE2, IPMA or PMP) complete your profile.

• Fluent in English. German or French desirable.

• A decade of experience, ideally with a focus on consulting assignments, securing cloud deployments to at least one of Azure, GCP or AWS, and the ability to articulate the differences in security offerrings between all three.

jobs.title: Praktikant:in - Steuerberatung (6 Monate)
jobs.description:
Im Bereich Unternehmenssteuern geht es nicht nur darum, Unternehmen bei der Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu unterstützen. Wir beraten national oder international tätige Unternehmen auch im Hinblick auf die relevanten Steuervorschriften und -entwicklungen. So können sie effiziente Strukturen aufbauen, die steuerlichen Auswirkungen möglicher Geschäftsmodelle berücksichtigen und Steuerrisiken vermeiden.
Als wertvolles Teammitglied berätst du Kund:innen (sowohl Unternehmen als auch Privatpersonen) in verschiedenen Steuerangelegenheiten und wirkst bei der Verwaltung anspruchsvoller Projekte mit.

• Unterstütze die Beratung juristischer Personen aus verschiedenen Branchen und Industrien in Fragen der Steuerbelange.

• Bearbeite herausfordernde und komplexe steuerliche Anfragen unserer nationalen und internationalen Kund: innen, um bestmögliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Führe anspruchsvolle Projekte wie national- und grenzüberschreitende Unternehmensumstrukturierungen, Kauf- und Verkaufstransaktionen sowie Anpassungen der Wertschöpfungskette durch.

• Profitiere vom erfolgreichen Austausch in der gesamten Steuer- und Rechtsabteilung, um dich sowohl persönlich als auch fachlich schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

• Masterabschluss an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise in Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften.

• Zeige dein Flair für rechtliche Fragestellungen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sowie deine Zahlen-Affinität. Bring aktiv deine Interessen ein und trage somit zum Erfolg unseres Teams bei.

• Zeige ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Steuern und bringe idealerweise bereits erste Vorkenntnisse mit. Sei flexibel, ausdauernd und offen für herausfordernde sowie komplexe Situationen.

• Sei stilsicher in Deutsch und verfüge über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Consigliamo anche le aziende nazionali o internazionali per quanto riguarda le relative normative e sviluppi fiscali. In questo modo, possono costruire strutture efficienti, tenere conto delle implicazioni fiscali dei possibili modelli di business ed evitare rischi fiscali. In qualità di membro del team prezioso, si consiglia ai clienti: in varie questioni fiscali (sia aziende che individui) e partecipare alla gestione di progetti impegnativi. - Sostenere le persone giuridiche di varie industrie e industrie in materia di questioni fiscali. - Modificare richieste fiscali complesse e complesse dai nostri clienti nazionali e internazionali per ottenere i migliori risultati possibili. - Esegui progetti impegnativi come la ristrutturazione, l'acquisto e le operazioni di vendita e la ristrutturazione delle imprese nazionali e transfrontaliere. - Approfittate dello scambio di successo nell'intero reparto fiscale e legale per svilupparvi sia personalmente che professionalmente. ##

jobs.title: Accounting- und Reportingspezialist:in mit Schwerpunkt Swiss GAAP FER
jobs.description:
• Du berätst bei der Einführung von kapitalmarktfähigen Reportings. Darüber hinaus leitest du unsere Kunden bei der Umstellung der Rechnungslegung auf Swiss GAAP FER und IFRS an und bist Ansprechpartner:in zu komplexen Bilanzierungsfragen (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS und Obligationenrecht).

• Du unterstützt die Kunden bei der Aufbereitung von Finanzinformationen insbesondere bei Unternehmenstransaktionen (z.B. Carve-out Financial Statements).

• Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der digitalen Transformation von Finanz- und Accountingprozessen.

• Durch die Leitung von (Teil)Projekten übernimmst du zunehmend mehr Verantwortung.

• Du entwickelst neue und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus und unterstützt aktiv den Akquisitionsprozess.

• Unser Erfolgsgeheimnis liegt in der Teamarbeit! Wir schätzen die persönliche Interaktion und Zusammenarbeit im Team und leben deine individuelle Flexibilität.

• Du bist Schweizer Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder verfügst über einen ähnlichen Abschluss (z.B. eidg. dipl. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling) oder du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss der Ausbildung.

• Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Prüfung, der Beratung oder in einer Accounting- und Reportingfunktion mit. Erfahrung im Bereich Konsolidierung bzw. mit Konzernrechnungen sind von Vorteil.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse des Rechnungslegungsstandards Swiss GAAP FER und der Rechnungslegung nach Obligationenrecht. IFRS Kenntnisse sind ein Plus.

• Vorzugsweise hast du Erfahrung mit BEPS Pillar 2.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Im Weiteren fühlst du dich sicher in der Kommunikation in Englisch.

• Dein Organisationstalent und deine Projektmanagement Fähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus.

Inoltre, guidai i nostri clienti nella transizione della contabilità verso Swiss GAAP FER e IFRS e sei il punto di contatto per domande complesse di bilanciamento (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS e diritto delle obbligazioni). Du supporta i clienti nella raccolta di informazioni finanziarie, in particolare per le transazioni aziendali (ad esempio, Carve-out Financial Statements). Supporta i nostri clienti nella trasformazione digitale dei processi finanziari e contabili. Gestisci (parziali) progetti e assumi sempre più responsabilità. Sviluppa nuove e mantieni relazioni con i clienti e supporta attivamente il processo di acquisizione. Il nostro segreto di successo è la collaborazione! Apprezziamo l'interazione personale e la collaborazione all'interno del team e viviamo la tua flexibilità individuale. ##
• Requisiti - Contabile o esperto in contabilità con un diploma di esperto in contabilità e controllo (ad esempio, esperto federale in contabilità e controllo) o sei in corso di formazione. - Ha almeno quattro anni di esperienza nel campo della revisione, consulenza o contabilità e reporting. - Conoscenze solide del standard di contabilità Swiss GAAP FER e del diritto delle obbligazioni. Conoscenze di IFRS sono un plus. - Preferibilmente hai esperienza con BEPS Pillar 2. - Conoscenze eccellenti del tedesco o francese in parola e scrittura. Inoltre, ti senti sicuro nella comunicazione in inglese. - Il tuo talento organizzativo e le tue capacità di gestione dei progetti ti distinguono.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description You advise on the introduction of capital market-friendly reporting. Additionally, you guide our clients through the transition of their accounting to Swiss GAAP FER and IFRS and are the point of contact for complex balance sheet questions (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS, and Obligation Law). You support clients in the preparation of financial information, especially for corporate transactions (e.g., Carve-out Financial Statements). Support our clients in the digital transformation of financial and accounting processes. Manage (partial) projects and take on more responsibility. Develop new and maintain client relationships and actively support the acquisition process. Our success secret is teamwork! We appreciate personal interaction and collaboration within the team and live your individual flexibility. ##
• Requirements - Swiss Certified Accountant or have a similar qualification (e.g., federal diploma in accounting and controlling) or are about to complete your training. - Have at least four years of experience in auditing, consulting, or accounting and reporting. - Have solid knowledge of the accounting standard Swiss GAAP FER and the accounting law. IFRS knowledge is a plus. - Preferably have experience with BEPS Pillar 2. - Have excellent German or French language skills in speech and writing. Furthermore, feel secure in communication in English. - Your organizational talent and project management skills distinguish you.

jobs.title: Director in Cybersecurity Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
As a Director, you will lead a global delivery team and work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex cyber security issues from strategy to execution. You will help to continue the exciting growth of our cybersecurity practice focusing on Manufacturing, Pharma and Industrial Products industries. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
Identify gaps in the market and spot opportunities to create value propositions to develop and grow cyber business.
Look for opportunities to scale efficiencies and new ways of working across multiple projects and environments.

• You will have the chance to pursue and deliver large and complex opportunities to solve our clients' security challenges via Transformation programs.This includes delivering Supply chain, OT, IAM, Managed Services Transformation programmes on a global scale, advising clients on how to define
Their Target Operating models to deal with IT-OT convergence, and building a winning team to continue our exciting growth in this space.
• You will be creating an environment where people and technology thrive together to accomplish more than they could apart.

• You will be driving and taking an ownership for developing strategic client relationships that help deliver what is best for our people and stakeholders

• You will have an influence and facilitate the creation of long-term relationships which add value to the firm and our clients

• 10+ years' experience in Manufacturing, Pharma, or Industrial Products.

• Strong communication, consulting, and persuasion skills.

• Fluent in English; German or French is a plus.

• Expertise in delivering complex security transformation projects.

• Collaborate with IT, Risk, Manufacturing, and Security teams.

• Build strategic relationships with clients and vendors.

• Experience with cybersecurity functions (e.g., OT Security, supply chain, incident response) and regulations (NIS2, EU CRA).

• Leadership and business development experience in multi-cultural environments.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Knowledge of industry standards (IEC-62243, NIST CS).

• Relevant certifications (CISSP, GICSP, etc.) beneficial.

descriptionByLocale.it: Come Director, guiderai un team di delivery globale e lavorerai all'interno di un gruppo di problem solver, contribuendo a risolvere problemi complessi di sicurezza informatica dalla strategia all'esecuzione. Contribuirai a sostenere la crescita entusiasmante della nostra practice di cybersecurity, con focus sui settori Manifatturiero, Pharma e Prodotti Industriali. Le competenze e responsabilità professionali di PwC per questo livello manageriale includono, ma non si limitano a: Identificare lacune nel mercato e cogliere opportunità per creare value proposition al fine di sviluppare e far crescere il business nella cybersecurity. Individuare opportunità per scalare l'efficienza e trovare nuovi modi di lavorare su più progetti e ambienti. Avrai la possibilità di acquisire e portare a termine opportunità grandi e complesse per risolvere le sfide di sicurezza dei clienti attraverso programmi di trasformazione. Ciò include la gestione di programmi di trasformazione relativi a Supply chain, OT, IAM e Managed Services su scala globale, la consulenza ai clienti su come definire i propri Target Operating Model per affrontare la convergenza IT-OT, e la creazione di un team vincente per continuare la nostra entusiasmante crescita in questo ambito. Creerai un ambiente in cui persone e tecnologia prospereranno insieme per raggiungere risultati superiori a quelli possibili singolarmente. Guiderai e ti approprierai dello sviluppo di relazioni strategiche con i clienti che contribuiscano a portare il meglio per le nostre persone e i nostri stakeholder. Avrai influenza e faciliterai la creazione di relazioni a lungo termine che aggiungano valore all'azienda e ai nostri clienti. Oltre 10 anni di esperienza nei settori Manifatturiero, Pharma o Prodotti Industriali. Solide capacità di comunicazione, consulenza e persuasione. Fluente in inglese; il tedesco o il francese sono un plus. Competenza nel portare a termine progetti complessi di trasformazione della sicurezza. Collaborare con team IT, Risk, Manufacturing e Security. Costruire relazioni strategiche con clienti e fornitori. Esperienza con funzioni di cybersecurity (es. OT Security, supply chain, incident response) e normative (NIS2, EU CRA). Esperienza di leadership e sviluppo del business in ambienti multiculturali. Solide capacità di problem solving e analisi. Conoscenza degli standard di settore (IEC-62243, NIST CS). Certificazioni rilevanti (CISSP, GICSP, ecc.) sono un vantaggio.
